translations.source: "Manje sinamagundane anezinyanga ezingu-4 angenawo ushukela ayenoshukela," wanezela.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: "We now have four-month-old puppies that were born without spots, but now have spots."

translations.source: UDkt. Ehud Ur, usolwazi wezokwelapha eNyuvesi yaseDalhousie eHalifax, eNova Scotia kanye nosihlalo womnyango wezokwelapha nowesayensi weCanadian Diabetes Association uxwayise ngokuthi ucwaningo lusanda kuqala.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, a medical researcher at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia, and the chairman of the medical and scientific department of the Canadian Diabetes Association, has cautioned that the research is only just beginning.

translations.source: Njengezinye izazi, unokungabaza ukuthi isifo sikashukela singalashwa, ephawula ukuthi lokhu okutholakele akubathinti asebevele benesifo sikashukela soHlobo loku-1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like other scientists, you might be wondering if there is a cure for shingles, noting that this discovery does not yet apply to those who have already contracted shingles of the first type.

translations.source: NgoMsombuluko, uSara Danius, unobhala wesikhathi sonkeweKomidi leNobel for Literature eSwedish Academy, umemezele obala phakathi nohlelo lomsakazo eSveriges Radio eSweden ikomiti, njengoba lingakwazi ukufinyelela kuBob Dylan ngokuqondile mayelana nokunqoba Umklomelo weNobel weZincwadi ka-2016, liyeke imizamo yokumfinyelela.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy's Nobel Committee for Literature, stated clearly during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden that, as the committee was unable to directly contact Bob Dylan regarding his 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, they had ceased their attempts to reach him.

translations.source: UDanius wathi, “Okwamanje asenzi lutho. Sengishayele ucingo ngaphinde ngathumela ama-imeyile kwabasondelene naye kakhulu asebenzisana nabo futhi ngathola izimpendulo ezinobungane. Okwamanje, lokho ngokuqinisekile kwanele.”
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: Daniel said, "For now, we're not taking any action. I've already called and emailed the people closest to him who work with him, and I've received some encouraging responses. For the time being, that's definitely enough."

translations.source: Phambilini, isikhulu esiphezulu sakwa-Ring, u-Jamie Siminoff, sathi le nkampani yaqala ngenkathi kungezwakali ukuthi kukhona ongqongqozayo emnyango uma esesitolo sakhe esisegalaji lakhe.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, stated that the company was founded after he realized there was no reliable way to know if someone was at his front door while he was at his garage.

translations.source: Wakhe insimbi yasemnyango yeWiFi, washo.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He built a government-grade WiFi system.

translations.source: USminoff uthe izintengo zanyuka ngemva kokuvela kwakhe embukwisweni we-Shark Tank ngo-2013 lapho iphaneli yohlelo yenqaba ukusekela ibhizinisi ngezimali.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Sminoff stated that prices increased after his company appeared on the television show "Shark Tank" in 2013, where the panel of investors agreed to invest in the business.

translations.source: Ekupheleni kuka-2017, iSiminoff savela ohlelweni lokuthengisa lukamabonakude iQVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2017, the Siminoff appeared on the QVC television shopping network.

translations.source: U-Ring wabuye waxazulula icala nenkampani ancintisana nayo yezokuphepha, i-ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring also resolved a dispute with its competitor in the security industry, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Nakuba umjovo wokulinga ubonakala ukwazi ukunciphisa ukufa okubangelwa yi-Ebola, kuze kube manje, ayikho imithi eboniswe ngokucacile ukuthi ifanelekela ukulapha isifo esikhona.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While the experimental drug appears to be effective in reducing mortality rates from Ebola, to date, there is no medication that has been definitively proven to be suitable for treating the disease.

translations.source: I-cocktail eyodwa nje emzimbeni, ZMapp, ekuqaleni ibonakale ithembisa ensimini, kodwa ngokocwaningo kubonisa ukuthi inomthelela omncane kunalowo obucatshwangwa ekuvimbeleni ukufa.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: A single antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in treating the disease, but research indicates that its effect is smaller than previously thought in preventing death.

translations.source: Ekuhloleni kwe-PALM, i-ZMapp yasebenza njengesifaniso, okusho ukuthi ososayensi bayisebenzisa njengesiqalo sokuqhathanisa futhi baqhathanisa amanye amakhambi amathathu okwelapha nayo.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: In the PALM study, ZMapp served as a control, meaning that researchers used it as a baseline for comparison and compared the other three experimental treatments to it.

translations.source: I-USA Gymnastics isekela incwadi yeKomiti lama-Olimpiki laseMelika futhi kwamukela isidingo esiphelele sokuba umndeni wama-Olimpiki ukhathaze indawo ephephile yabadlali bethu bonke.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics supports the letter from the U.S. Olympic Committee and welcomes the full commitment of the Olympic family to ensuring a safe environment for all of our athletes.

translations.source: Sivumelana nesitatimende se-USOC ukuthi izintshisekelo zabadlali kanye namaqembu, kanye nemidlalo yabo, zingakhonzwa kangcono ngokuyaphambili ngoshintsho olunenjongo phakathi kwenhlangano yethu, kunokuthathelwa izitifiketi.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of athletes and teams, and their sports, can be better served through proactive change within our organization, rather than through external certifications.

translations.source: I-USA Gymnastics isekela uphenyo oluzimele olungaveza ukukhanya  ngokuhlukunyezwa kwenxenye echazwe ngesibindi yilabo abasinde kuLarry Nassar obekungenzeka kungabonwa ngayo isikhathi eside kangaka futhi yamukela noma iziphi izinguquko ezidingekayo nezifanele.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics supports independent research that may shed light on the abuse suffered by those affected by Larry Nassar, and it is committed to addressing any issues that may have contributed to the situation and to implementing any necessary and appropriate changes.

translations.source: I-USA Gymnastic kanye ne-USOC zinomgomo ofanayao — ukwenza umdlalo wezokuzivivinya komzimba, kanye neminye, iphephe ngangokunokwenzeka ukuba abadlali balandele amaphupho wabo endaweni ephephile, enhle kanye nenika amandla.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics and the USOC share a common goal: to make sports, including gymnastics, as safe as possible so that athletes can pursue their dreams in a safe, positive, and empowering environment.

translations.source: Kuyo yonke iminyaka yawo-1960, uBrzezinski wasebenzela uJohn F. Kennedy njengomeluleki wakhe bese uhulumeni kaLyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: Throughout the 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and later served in the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.

translations.source: Phakathi nokhetho luka-1976 waluleka uCarter ngemithetho yakwamanye amazwe, bese wasesebenza njenge-National Security Advisor (NSA) kusuka ngo-1977 kuya ku-1981, ethatha isikhundla sikaHenry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1976 election, Carter was criticized for his foreign policy, and he subsequently appointed him as the National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: Njenge-NSA, usize uCarter ngokuphatha izindaba zezwe ngokusemthethweni, njenge-Camp David Accords, 1978; ukwenza kube nobudlelwane obuvamile phakathi kweMelika neShayina ekupheleni kwawo-1970; Ushintsho lwase-Iran, olwaholela enhlekeleleni yezithunjwa zase-Iran, ngo-1979; kanye nokuhlasela kweSoviet e-Afghanistan, ngo-1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: Like the NSA, Carter relied on him to handle sensitive international matters, such as the Camp David Accords in 1978; to establish normalized relations between the United States and China in the late 1970s; to manage the Iranian revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis in 1979; and to respond to the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979.

translations.source: Ifilimu, eno-Ryan Gosling noEmma Stone, ikhethelwe ukuwina kuzo zonke izigaba ezinkulu.

translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone were both awarded the Best Actor and Best Actress titles, respectively.

translations.hypothesis: Some of the selected categories include: Best Visuals, Best Director, Best Costume Design, Best Film Editing, Music, Product Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing, and Original Film Script.

translations.source: Izingoma ezimbili ezivela kwifilimu, i-Audition (The Fools Who Dream) kanye ne-City of Stars, zithole ukuqokelwa kwengoma yangempela ehamba phambili. Isitudiyo se-Lionsgate sikhethwe izikhathi ezingu-26 — ukudlula noma esiphi Isitudiyo.

translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the film, "Audition (The Fools Who Dream)" and "City of Stars," have been nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Song. The Lionsgate studio has received a total of 26 nominations, surpassing any other studio.

translations.source: Ntambama ngeSonto, uMongameli waseMelika u-Donald Trump, esitatimendeni esikhishwe unobhala wephephandaba, umemezele ukuthi amasosha aseMelika azoshiya elaseSiriya.

translations.hypothesis: On Sunday afternoon, U.S. President Donald Trump, in a statement released by the White House, announced that U.S. troops would be withdrawing from Syria.

translations.source: Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amanye ama-dinosaur ayenezimpaphe, inkolelo-mbono ebanzi kakade, kepha inikezela imininingwane imivubukulo engayinikezi ngokujwayelekile, njengombala nokuhleleka kwezinhlangothi ezintathu.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This not only confirms the long-held belief that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, but it also provides fascinating details that are rarely available, such as the color and arrangement of the feathers.

translations.source: . Ososayensi bathi iplamu lalesi silwane lalinesifuba esinsundu ngaphezulu siphaphathekile nokumibalabala emaceleni.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say that the animal's plumage had a predominantly red chest and a mottled pattern on its flanks.

translations.source: Ucwaningo lunikeza nokuqonda ngokuvela kwezimpaphe ezinyonini.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The research provides insights into the emergence of wrinkles over time.

translations.source: Ngenxa yokuthi izimpaphe zama-dinosaur aziso isiqu esikhule kahle, osibizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinezinye izici zezimpaphe — izindlendla kanye nama-barbule — abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi i-rachis cishe bekungukwakheka kokuziphendukela kunalezinye izici.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Because dinosaur bones do not show the characteristic growth pattern, known as the rachis, but do possess other features of bones—like ridges and pores—researchers have suggested that the rachis was likely a developmental feature that was lost over time as these other features became more prominent.

translations.source: Ukwakheka kwezimpaphe kusikisela ukuthi bezingasetshenziselwa ukundiza kodwa kunalokho ukulawula ukushisa kanye nokuzibonakalisa. Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, nakuba lona kungumsila we-dinosaur encane, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The structure of the bones suggests that they were not used for flight, but rather for temperature regulation and display. Researchers suggest that, although it may have been a small dinosaur, the specimen possesses ancient feathers and not the plumage of a modern bird.

translations.source: Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, ngisho noma lona kungumsila we-dinosaur, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers suggest that, even though it may resemble a dinosaur claw, the sample actually consists of ancient plant material and not a female animal's claw.

translations.source: Ibhomu esemotweni eqhume esikhungweni samaphoyisa eGaziantep, eTheki izolo ekuseni ibulale amaphoyisa amabili futhi yalimaza abantu abanye abangaphezu kweshumi nambili.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: A car bomb exploded near a police station in Gaziantep, Turkey, yesterday morning, killing two police officers and injuring more than a dozen other people.

translations.source: Ihhovisi lombusi lithe abayishumi nesishiyagalolunye babengamaphoyisa.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The governor's office stated that there were twenty-six police officers.

translations.source: Amaphoyisa athi asola osolwa ngokuba isosha leDaesh (ISIL) elinesikhundla ngenxa yalokhu kuhlasela.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police have accused the suspects of being members of the Daesh (ISIS) terrorist group and are investigating them for potential involvement in attacks.

translations.source: Bathole ukuthi ilanga lisebenza ngezimiso eziyisisekelo njengezinye izinkanyezi: umsebenzi wezinkanyezi zonke ohlelweni kutholakale ukuthi uqondiswa ukukhanya kwazo, ukuphenduka kwazo, futhi hhayi okunye.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: It has been determined that the sun, like other stars, operates based on fundamental principles: the behavior of all stars in the system is governed by their light, their rotation, and nothing else.

translations.source: Ukukhanya nokuphenduka kusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuthola inombolo yeRossby yenkanyezi, ehlobene nokugeleza kwe-plasma.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: The principles of illumination and reflection are used together to determine the Rossby number of a star, which is related to the plasma flow.

translations.source: Uma i-Rossby inenombolo encane, inkanyezi ayibi namandla ngokuphathelene nokuhlehla kazibuthe.
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: When the Rossby number is small, the star does not have enough influence to cause significant deviations in the orbit.

translations.source: Phakathi naloluhambo, u-Iwasaki wahlangabezana nezinkinga kaningi.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: During that journey, Iwasaki encountered many challenges.

translations.source: Ubanjwe inkunzi yizigcwelegcwele zasolwandle, wahlaselwa yinja enesifo sobuhlanya e-Tibet, wabalekela umshado e-Nepal bese waboshwa eNdiya.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He was chased by aggressive seagulls, attacked by a rabid dog in Tibet, fled a wedding in Nepal, and was arrested in India.

translations.source: Isimiso se-802.11n sisebenza kuwo womabili amafrikhwensi angu-2.4Ghz no-5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4 GHz and 5.0 GHz frequency bands.

translations.source: Lokhu kuzoyivumela ukuthi ihambisane nezinhlelo zakudala ze-802.11a, i-802.11b kanye ne-802.11g, uma nje isikhungo sesiteshi sinemisakazo emibili.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This will allow it to be compatible with older 802.11a, 802.11b, and 802.11g standards, provided that the access point has two radios.

translations.source: Ijubane lika-802.11n liphezulu kakhulu kunelangaphambili elaligcina ejubaneni elingu-600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: The 802.11n standard offers a significantly higher speed than its predecessor, which previously had a maximum speed of 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: UDuvall, oshadile nonezingane ezimbili ezindalaa, akazange ahlabe u-Miller umxhwele, lowo otshelwe indaba.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, who is married with two children, did not deny the allegations made against him by Miller.

translations.source: Lapho ecelwa ukuthi aphawule, u-Miller uthe, “U-Mike ukhuluma kakhulu phakathi nokuthethwa kwecala...bengizilungiselela ngakho angikuzwanga ayekusho.”

translations.hypothesis: When asked to comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the trial... I was prepared for that, so I didn't pay attention to what he was saying."

translations.source: Sizophumelela ukunciphisa inani lomoya ongcolile ngesikali se-GDP ngezinga eliphawulekayo ngo-2020 ukusuka esilinganisweni sango-2005, kusho u-Hu.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: According to Hu, they achieved a significant reduction in the amount of air pollution relative to the GDP in 2020, compared to the levels recorded in 2005.

translations.hypothesis: He did not specify any reduction targets, stating that they would be determined based on the performance of the Chinese economy.

translations.source: UHu ukhuthaze amazwe athuthukayo "ukugwema indlela yakudala yokugcolisa kuqala bese uhlanza kamuva."
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: The World Health Organization (WHO) has urged developed countries to "avoid the old approach of prioritizing vaccination and then cleaning up afterwards."

translations.source: Wanezela ukuthi “akumelwe, nokho, bacelwe bathathe ukuzibophezela okungaphezu kwesigaba sabo sentuthuko, imithwalo yemfanelo kanye namakhono.”
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added, "However, they should not be asked to take on responsibilities, burdens, or challenges that exceed their level of development, equity, and capabilities."

translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.

translations.hypothesis: It is a warning: No one can guarantee that any current initiative in Iraq will end the conflict, the widespread violence, or the prevailing instability.

translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report strongly criticizes nearly all aspects of the current Iraqi parliament and calls for immediate and significant reforms.

translations.source: Okokuqala phakathi kokutusa kwayo okungu-78 ukuthi isinyathelo sokuxhumana kumelwe sithathe ngaphambi kokuphela kwalonyaka ukuvikela imingcele yase-Iraq ekungeneleni konya kanye nasekumiseni kabusha ubuhlobo bokuxhumana nomakhelwane bayo.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: One of the key priorities outlined in the 78th resolution is that a communication initiative must be implemented before the end of the year to protect Iraq's borders from incursions and to restore relations with its neighbors.

translations.source: Ilungu lesigele lamanje kanye noNkosikazi kaMongameli wase-Argentina uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner umemezele ukungenela kwakhe ukhetho lokuba umongameli izolo ntambama eLa Plata, idolobha elingamakhilomitha angu-50 (amamayela angu-31) kusuka eBuenos Aires.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The current Vice President and wife of the former President of Argentina, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, announced her candidacy for president yesterday afternoon in La Plata, a city located approximately 50 kilometers (31 miles) from Buenos Aires.

translations.source: UNkk. Kirchner umemezelo inhloso yakhe yokukhankasela ukuba umongameli eThiyetheni yase-Argentina, indawo efanayo ayisebenzisele ukuqala umkhankaso wakhe wokuba ilunga leSigele njengelunga lamanxusa esifunda sase-Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Mr. Kirchner announced his intention to run for president in Argentina, the same role he previously held. He also used the announcement to launch his campaign for a seat in the Senate, representing the province of Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Inkulumo-mpikiswano idalwe ukuphikisana ngokuchitha imali eningi yokusiza kanye nokwakha kabusha ngemva kokudlula kweSiphepho iKatrina; leyo abesikhwama sezwe abadla ngoludala abayibize sakudlala ngokuthi "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The controversy arose from the significant amount of money spent on aid and reconstruction efforts following Hurricane Katrina; a sum that some older members of the organization, referring to it informally, called "Bush's New Orleans Deal."

translations.source: Ukugxekwa okukhulu komzamo wokwakha kabusha kugxile ekuklomeliseni ukuvuselelwa kwezinkontileka ukuze baqonde ezangaphakathi zase-Washington.
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The main criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the rewarding of companies that demonstrated an understanding of Washington's internal workings.

translations.source: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine baya eRoma enkonzweni yomngcwabo eRoma.
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: More than four million people visited Rome for the funeral services held there.

translations.source: Inani labantu ababekhona lalilikhulu kangangokuba kwakungenzeki ukuba wonke umuntu angene enkonzweni yomngcwabo eSt. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people present was so large that it was impossible for everyone to enter the funeral service at St. Peter's Square.

translations.source: Izikrini ezinkulu eziningana zethelevishini zifakiwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene eRoma ukwenzela ukuthi abantu babukele umcimbi.
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Several large television screens have been installed in various locations throughout Rome so that people can watch the event.

translations.source: Kwamanye amazwe amaningi waseNtaliyane nasemhlabeni wonke, ngokukhethekile ePoland, ukumiswa okufanayo kwenziwe, okubukwe abantu abaningi kakhulu.
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: In many countries, particularly in Italy and around the world, including Poland, similar installations have been created, attracting a large number of visitors.

translations.source: Abezomlando bagxeke imithetho edlule yeFBI ngokugxila emacaleni alula ukuwaxazulula, ikakhulukazi amacala okuntshontshwa kwezimoto, ngenjongo yokukhuphula izinga lokuphumelela le nkampani.
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing on easily solvable cases, particularly those involving car theft, in an effort to artificially inflate the agency's success rate.

translations.source: Ukhongolose waqala ukuxhasa ngezimali uhlelo olungamanyala ngesikhwama sezwe ngo-2005 futhi wachaza ukuthi i-FBI kumelwe inikele ngezisebenzi ezingu-10 ezithombeni ezingcolile zabantu abadala.
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: The senator began financially supporting the program, which involved the use of state resources, in 2005, and stated that the FBI should provide 10 agents to investigate the disturbing images of adults.

translations.source: U-Robin Uthappa wenze amaphuzu aphezulu kwi-innings, ama-runs angu-70 emabholeni angu-41 kuphela eshaya o-four abangu-11 kanye no-six abangu-2.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa scored the highest number of runs in the innings, with 70 runs from just 41 balls, hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.source: Amadoda ashayayo adlalela phakathi, u-Sachin Tendulkar no-Rahul Dravid, bedlale kahle futhi benza umsebenzisano wokugijima ka-100.
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The experienced batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, played well and together scored 100 runs.

translations.source: Kodwa, ngemva kokuba kukhiswhe ukaputeni wayo, iNdiya yenze amaphuzu angu-36 kuphela ilahlekelwa amawikhethi angu-7 kuze kube sekugcineni kwengxenye yomdlalo.
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: However, after losing its captain, India only managed to score 36 runs before losing 7 wickets by the end of the innings.

translations.source: UMongameli waseMelika uGeorge W. Bush wafika eSingapore ekuseni ngoLwezi 16, eqalisa uhambo lwakhe lweviki lokuvakashela i-Asia.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore early on Tuesday, November 16th, marking the beginning of his week-long tour of Asia.

translations.source: Wabingelelwa yiPhini likaNdunankulu wase-Singapore u-Wong Kan Seng futhi baxoxa ngezohwebo kanye nezokuvakasha noNdunankulu waseSingapore uLee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: They were welcomed by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister, Wong Kan Seng, and discussed trade and tourism with Singapore's Prime Minister, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: Ngemva kweviki lokulahlekelwa okhethweni lwaphakathi nesikhathi, uBush watshela izilaleli ngokukhulisa kokuhwebelana e-Asia.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: Following a week of mid-season losses, Bush addressed his audience about the increasing volatility in the Asian markets.

translations.source: UNdunankulu uStephen Harper uvumile ukuthumela uhulumeni 'Umthetho woMoya Ohlanzekile' ukuba uhlolwe ikomiti lamaqembu onke, ngaphambi kokuba ufundwe okwesibili, ngemva komhlangano wangoLwesibili wemizuzu engu-25 nomhloli weNDP uJack Layton kuyi-PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's "Clean Air Act" to a committee of all parties for review, before it is debated a second time, following a 25-minute meeting on Tuesday between the Prime Minister and NDP leader Jack Layton at the Prime Minister's Office.

translations.source: U-Layton ucele kube nezinguquko kumthethosivivinywa wezemvelo we-conservatives ngesikhathi somhlangano nama-PM, ecela kube “nokubhalwa kabusha okuphelele” komthethosivivinywa wezemvelo weqembu le-Conservative.
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton called for changes to the Conservative party's environmental policy during a meeting with the Prime Minister, urging for a "complete rewrite" of the party's environmental platform.

translations.source: Kusukela ngesikhathi Uhulumeni Wenhlangano Yamazwe ungenela ekuphatheni uxhaso lwesibhedlela i-Mersey eDevonport, eTasmania, uhulumeni wezwe kanye namanye amalungu kahulumeni wenhlangano yamazwe asola lesi senzo njengesandulela sokhetho lukahulumeni oluzokwenziwa ngoLwezi.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the federal government intervened in the management of the Mersey Hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and other members of parliament have criticized this action as an attempt to influence the upcoming federal election.

translations.source: Kodwa uNdunankulu uJohn Howard uthe umthetho kwakungowokulondoloza izakhiwo zesibhedlela ukuba zingabekwa ezingeni eliphansi uhulumani waseTasmania, ngokunikeza izigidi ezingu-AUD$45.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: However, Premier John Howard stated that the law was intended to protect hospital buildings from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, by providing AUD$45 million in funding.

translations.source: Ngokwencwajana yezindaba yakamuva, amazinga omthamo olwandle aveze ukuthi i-tsunami yenzekile. Bekune-tsunami ebekhona erekhodwe eduze nePago Pago kanye neNiue.
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: According to the latest news report, ocean wave measurements have indicated that a tsunami has occurred. A tsunami was detected near Pago Pago and Niue.

translations.source: Awukho umonakalo omkhulu noma ukulimala okubikiwe eTonga, kodwa ugesi ubungekho okwesikhashana, lokho okubikwa ukuthi kuvimebele iziphathimandla zaseTonga ekutholeni isexwayiso setsunami esikhishwe iPTWC.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There were no major damages or injuries reported in Tonga, but there was a brief power outage, which reportedly prevented the Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC (Pacific Tsunami Warning Center).

translations.source: Izikole eziyishumi nanye eHawaii ezisendaweni noma eziseduze nogu bezivaliwe ngoLwesithathu wonke nangaphezu kokususwa kwesixwayiso.
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: Eleven schools in Hawaii, either located within or near the affected area, were closed on Wednesday, even after the advisory was lifted.

translations.source: Umongameli waseMelika uGeorge W Bush wasamukela isimemezelo.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: The former U.S. President, George W. Bush, welcomed the announcement.

translations.source: Umkhulumeli kaBush uGordon Johndroe ubize isithembiso seNyakatho Korea "ngesinyathelo esiyinhloko emgomweni wokususwa kwezikhali zenuzi okungafakazelwa enhlonhlweni yaseKorea."
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: North Korea's pledge, according to Bush administration spokesman Gordon Johndroe, is "a significant step towards the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."

translations.source: Isiphepho seshumi esinikwe igama senkathi yeziPhepho zase-Atlantic, iSiphepho Sendawo Efudumele uJerry, saqala oLwandlekazini i-Atlantic namuhla.
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, Tropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

translations.source: INational Hurricane Center (NHC) ithi kulenkathi uJerry ingaba nosongo ezweni.
translations.reference: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) has stated that the storm Jerry is currently posing a threat to the country.

translations.source: I-U.S. Corps of Engineers lilinganise ukuthi ukuna kwemvula engama-intshi angu-6 angafohla uhide lwezindundumela ezimoshekile esikhathini esidlule.
translations.reference: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Corps of Engineers has determined that the recent rainfall of 6 inches may have breached the levee protecting the dried-up reservoir.

translations.source: I-Ninth Ward, elabonakala likhukhuleka ngamagxathu angu-20 phakathi Nesiphepho uKatrina, okwamanje linamanzi asokhalweni njengoba amanzi elweqe ngaphezulu udonga lokuvimba amanzi oluseduze.
translations.reference: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.hypothesis: The Ninth Ward, which appeared calm during the 20 episodes following Hurricane Katrina, is now experiencing flooding as water has breached the nearby levee.

translations.source: Amanzi ayachitheka ngaphezu kohide lwezindundumela engxenyeni engamafidi angu-100 ububanzi.
translations.reference: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.hypothesis: Water sprayed from a sprinkler system covering an area approximately 100 feet wide.

translations.source: Umqondisi weCommons u-Adam Cuerden uzwakalise ukukhungatheka kwakhe ngokusulwa ngemva kokukhuluma ne-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.
translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: The director of the Commons, Adam Cuerden, expressed his disappointment after being blocked from communicating with Wikinews last month.

translations.source: "Yena [uWales] ngokuyisisekelo ukhulume amanga kusuka ekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokushaya sengathi lokhu bekungenxa yezizathu ezingokomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokuzishaya sengathi wayesilalele, kuze kube sekususweni kobuciko bakhe."
translations.reference: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.hypothesis: "From the very beginning, [Wales] fundamentally misrepresented the situation. First, by claiming it was for legitimate reasons. Second, by feigning ignorance, right up until the point of its removal."

translations.source: Ukudineka komphakathi kwaholela emzamweni wamanje wokubhala umthetho ophathelene nezindaba zobulli ezingosini ezihlinzeka izinkulungwane ngezindaba ezigunyaziwe ezisemthethweni.
translations.reference: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.hypothesis: The growing social awareness has led to the current movement of drafting legislation related to online bullrings, aiming to provide millions with regulated and legitimate access to this content.

translations.source: Umsebenzi owenziwe bekungowomcabango kakhulu, kodwa uhlelo lubhalelwe ukulingisa okubonwe emthaleni weSagittarius.
translations.reference: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: The work was highly imaginative, but the program was designed to simulate what is observed in the Sagittarius region.

translations.source: Umphumela iqembu ebeliwulindele ubuzobangelwa amandla adonsayo phakathi kwesigaxa esimnyama somthala nesigaxa esimnyama somthala i-Milky way.
translations.reference: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.hypothesis: The phenomenon the team is anticipating will be caused by the gravitational forces between the black hole and the black hole at the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

translations.source: Njengoba inyanga idonsa umhlaba, ibangele amagagasi olwandle, kanjalo neMilky Way idonsa umthala weSagittarius.
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the moon exerts a gravitational pull on the Earth, causing ocean tides, so too does the Milky Way exert a gravitational pull on the Sagittarius stream.

translations.source: Ososayensi bakwazile ukuphetha ngokuthi izigaxa ezimnyama zithinta ezinye izigaxa ezimnyama ngendlela izigaxa ezijwayelekile ezenza ngayo.
translations.reference: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have discovered that black holes can interact with other black holes in the same way that ordinary matter does.

translations.source: Isichasiselo sithi okumnyama okuzungeze umthala kuzungeze umthala njengendingilizi yokukhanya yohlobo oluthile, futhi kwenziwe ngezinto ezincane eziningi.
translations.reference: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.hypothesis: The dark area surrounding the stream appears as a sort of light halo, and it is composed of many small particles.

translations.source: Imibiko kamabonakude ibonisa intuthu emhlophe iphuma esitshalweni.
translations.reference: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.hypothesis: The television reports showed white smoke emerging from the chimney.

translations.source: Iziphathimandla zasendaweni zixwayisa abahlali abaseduze nendawo yemboni ukuba bahlale ezindlini, bacime izipholisa-moya futhi bangaphuzi amanzi ompompi.
translations.reference: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.hypothesis: Local authorities are advising residents living near the industrial area to stay indoors, turn off their air conditioners, and avoid using pumps that draw water.

translations.source: Ngokwenkampani yenuzi yaseJapan, imisebe yenuzi ye-caesium ne-iodine itholakale endaweni yokusebenzela.
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Japanese nuclear company, traces of cesium and iodine, which are radioactive elements, were detected in the work area.

translations.source: Iziphathimandla zicabangela ukuthi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziqukathi ebeziqukethe amafutha e-uranium endaweni yokusebenzela kungenzeka ukuthi ziqhumile futhi ziyavuza.
translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: Authorities are investigating whether this indicates that the containers holding uranium fuel at the facility may have ruptured and leaked.

translations.source: UDkt. Tony Moll wathola i-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) esifundeni saseNingizimu Afrika KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll discovered Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal province of South Africa.

translations.source: Engxoxweni, uthe okuhlukile okusha "kukhathaza kakhulu futhi kuyethusa ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokufa kwabantu."
translations.reference: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.hypothesis: In the conversation, he stated that the new variant was "particularly concerning and alarming due to the high rate of mortality."

translations.source: Ezinye iziguli zithole igciwane esibhedlela, kucabanga uDkt. Moll, futhi okungenani ababili bekuyizisebenzi zempilo zasesibhedlela.
translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: According to Dr. Moll, some patients contracted the infection at the hospital, and at least two of them were healthcare workers.

translations.source: Ngesikhathi sonyaka owodwa, umuntu othelelekile angathelela abantu asondelene nabo abangu-10 kuya ku-15.
translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: During the first year, a person who has just given birth may experience up to 10 to 15 contractions per hour.

translations.source: Nokho, iphesenti le-XDR-TB eningini labantu abaphila nesifo sofuba kubukeka siphansi; u-6,000 wabantu abangu-330,000 abathintekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi eNingizimu Afrika.
translations.reference: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: However, the prevalence of XDR-TB among people living with tuberculosis appears to be relatively low; out of 330,000 individuals affected in South Africa, approximately 6,000 have been diagnosed with XDR-TB at some point.

translations.source: Amasathelayithi, womabili anesisindo esingaphezu  kwamaphawundi angu-1,000, futhi zihamba cishe ngamamayela angu-17,500 ngehora, zishayisene amamayela angu-491 ngaphezu koMhlaba.
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: Two satellites, each weighing over 1,000 pounds, are traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour and are orbiting Earth at an altitude of 491 miles.

translations.source: Ososayensi bathi ukuqhuma okudalwe ukushayisana kwakukukhulu.
translations.reference: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the explosion was caused by a large-scale conflict.

translations.source: Basazama ukuthola ukuthi kube kukhulu kangakanani ukugqubuzana nokuthi uMhlaba uzothinteka kanjani.
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.hypothesis: They are trying to determine the extent of the impact and how the Earth will be affected.

translations.source: I-United States Strategic Command yehhovisi loMnyango Wezokuvikela e-U.S. ilandelela le mfucumfucu.
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Strategic Command, a branch of the U.S. Department of Defense, is investigating this matter.

translations.source: Imiphumela yokuhlaziya udaba izobhalwa kuyiwebhusayithi.
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.hypothesis: The results of the analysis will be published on the website.

translations.source: Udokotela owayesebenza eSibhedlela seziNgane sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania uzobekwa icala lokubulala ngesisihluku ngemva kokuba unina etholakale eshonile endaweni yokubeka izimpahla ngemuva kwemoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho iziphathimandla e-Ohio.
translations.reference: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.hypothesis: A doctor who previously worked at the Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, will be charged with manslaughter after his mother was found dead in the trunk of his car on Wednesday, according to Ohio authorities.

translations.source: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, utholwe eBlue Ash,  e-Ohio, idolobha elicishe libe amamayela angu-15 enyakatho yeCincinnati elele phansi eceleni komgwaqo ngesikibha kanye nezingubo zangaphansi ebonakala sengathi unikwe imithi eminingi yezinhlungu.
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a city about 15 miles north of Cincinnati. She was lying on the ground near a road, wearing a dress and undergarments, and appeared to have been given a large amount of pain medication.

translations.source: Uqondise izikhulu kuyi-Oldsmobile Intrigue yakhe eyayikude ngamafidi angu- 500.
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: He directed the authorities to his Oldsmobile Intrigue, which was parked about 500 feet away.

translations.source: Izinhlelo zemijovo okumelwe ithunyelwe ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu ngokomlando kulonyaka zilibazisiwe ngenxa yokungabi nemali nokungathathwa njengokubalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifo.

translations.source: Wayetholakele nasekudwebeni imali eyiphepha yamazwe amaningi, izibonelo zakamuva zomsebenzi wakhe zihlanganisa imifanekiso yoNdunankulu phambi kwemali yephepha yaseCanada engu-$5 kanye no-$100.

translations.source: Ngemva kokuba kwakhiwe idamu ngo-1963, izikhukhula zenkathi ethile yonyaka ezazisabalalisa inzika emfuleni wonke zamiswa.

translations.source: E-France, ukuvota kwakuyisiko lobuchwepheshe obuphansi: abavoti bazihlukanisa bodwa ebhokisini, babeka iphepha eliphrintiwe ekuqaleni elibonisa ukhetho lwabo ngaphakathi kwemvilophi.
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.hypothesis: In France, the voting process was a low-tech affair: voters would individually enter a booth, place a pre-printed ballot showing their choice inside an envelope.

translations.source: Ngemva kokuba iziphathimandla ziqinisekise ubuqu bomuntu ovotayo, abavotayo balahlela izimvilophu ebhokisini lamaphepha okuvota futhi basayine uhlu lwabavotayo.
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.hypothesis: After officials verify the voter's identity, the poll workers prepare the ballot and place it in the ballot box, then they sign the voter list.

translations.source: Umthetho wokhetho waseFrance kunalokho uhlanganisa ngokuqinile ukuqulwa kwamacala.
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.hypothesis: The French electoral law, unlike some others, strictly prohibits the discussion of specific cases during elections.

translations.source: Kusukela ngo-1988, amabhokisi amaphepha okuvota kumelwe kube abonisayo ukuze abavoti kanye nezibukeli bafakazele ukuthi azikho izimvilophu ezikhona lapho kuqala ukuvota nokuthi azikho izimvilophu ezifakwayo ngaphandle kwalezo zabavoti ababalwe ngokufanelekile nabagunyaziwe.
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can verify that they are empty when the voting begins and that no ballots are being inserted into the box other than those of properly registered and authorized voters.

translations.source: Amakhandidethi angathumela abameli ukuze babone zonke izingxenye zenqubo. Kusihlwa, amavoti abalwa amavolontiya abekwe iso elibukhali, alandela izinqubo ezithile.
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.hypothesis: Candidates can send representatives to observe all stages of the process. In the evening, the votes are counted by volunteers who are carefully monitored and follow specific procedures.

translations.hypothesis: The pH level, which is determined by the concentration of hydrogen ions (H+), is a measurable chemical property.

translations.source: Ama-ion e-hydrogen amaphrothoni lawo ekususwe ama-elektroni wawo kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu weHydrogen enziwa iphrothoni elilodwa kanye ne-elektroni elilodwa).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are formed when a hydrogen atom loses its electron(s) (since a hydrogen atom consists of one proton and one electron).

translations.source: Yaluzisa izimpuphu ezimbili ezomile bese, ngezandla ezihlanzekile ezimanzi, uzicindezele zibe yindingiliza.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: She moistened two dry sponges and, using clean, wet hands, squeezed them into a flat shape.

translations.source: Umswakamo osezandleni zakho uzohlangana nongqimba olungaphandle, okuzoba nomuzwa oxakayo futhi kwenze uhlobo lwegobongo.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: The cream you are holding will interact with the outer layer of your skin, creating a cooling sensation and a smooth, even texture.

translations.source: Amadolobha waseHarappa kanye naseMohenjo-daro ayenedlu yangasese eshaywayo cishe kuzo zonke izindlu, ehlanganiswe nendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokuthutha indle.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had private bathrooms in almost every house, connected to a sophisticated drainage system.

translations.source: Insalela yamapayipi athutha indle itholakele ezindlini zamadolobha wase-Minoan waseKhrithi nase-Santorini eGreece.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: Remnants of clay pipes used for drainage systems have been discovered in the urban dwellings of the Minoan civilization in Crete and Santorini, Greece.

translations.source: Zazikhona izindlu zangasese eGibhithe, e, kanye naseShayina yamandulo. Empucukweni yaseRoma, izindlu zangasese kwesinye isikhathi kwakuyingxenye yezindlu zokugezela zomphakathi lapho abasilisa nabesifazana babehlangana ndawonye.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: Private baths existed in ancient Egypt, as well as in ancient China. In Roman society, private baths were sometimes part of public bath complexes, where men and women would gather together.

translations.source: Uma ushayela ucingo umuntu othile okude ngamamayela ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isiphuphutheki.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a telecommunications device.

translations.source: Isiphuphutheki esisemkhathini sithola ucingo bese siluthumela emuva ezansi, cishe ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite in orbit receives a signal and then transmits it back down to Earth, approximately at that time.

translations.source: Isethilayithi ithunyelwe emkhathini kusentshenziswa irokhethi. Ososayensi basebenzise izibona kude ezisemkhathini ngoba umkhathi uphazamisa okunye kokukhanya kwethu kanye nokubona.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite was launched into space using a rocket. Scientists used remote sensors in space because the atmosphere distorts some of our light and visual signals.

translations.source: Kudingeka irokhethi enkulu engaphezu kwamafidiangu-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isiphuphutheki noma ithelisikobho emkhathini.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: A large rocket, exceeding 100 feet in height, is required to launch a satellite or spacecraft into orbit.

translations.source: Isondo seliguqule umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu ukuthi isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika indlela yokuthutha elula neshesha kakhulu.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: Technology has transformed the world in remarkable ways. One of the most significant advancements is that technology has provided us with easier and faster modes of transportation.

translations.source: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zokuthutha.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: It refers to trains, cars, and other modes of transportation.

translations.source: Ngaphansi kwazo kukhona amakati amancanyana ngobukhulu adla inyama ebanjelwa ukudliwakusuka kunogwaja kuya ezinyamazaneni.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: Underneath them, there are smaller cats that prey on meat, ranging in size from rodents to birds.

translations.source: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amaningi amancane (kuhlanganise namakati afuywayo azizulelayo) adla izilwanyane ezizingelwayo eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, izilwane eziququdayo, izibankwa, kanye nezinyoni.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are many small predators (including some wild cats) that prey on a variety of animals, such as insects, rodents, reptiles, and birds.

translations.source: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo umcabango wesikhundla, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye elinawo olenza lingancintisani namanye.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The secret to their success lies in the concept of specialization, with each individual cat having a unique role that prevents them from competing with one another.

translations.source: Amabhubesi angamakati anobudlelwane kakhulu, aphila ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi umhlambi.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: African elephants are highly social animals and live in large groups called herds.

translations.source: Imihlambi yakhiwa iduna elilodwa noma amathathu ahlobene, ngokufanayo nezinsikazi ezintathu kanye namawundlu.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: The herd is typically led by a single bull or a group of up to three related bulls, along with three cows and their offspring.

translations.source: Abesifazane ngokuvamile bahlobene, okuwumndeni omkhulu wodadewabo noma amadodakazi.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: Women are often related, forming a large extended family of sisters or cousins.

translations.source: Ivuyo lamabhubesi liziphatha njengomhlambi wamanketshane, izilwane ezifana namabhubesi ngokumangalisayo (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ngokuziphatha, kanye futhi nokuba yingozi ezilwaneni ezizizingelayo.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: The behavior of hyenas is often likened to that of wolves, as they are remarkably similar to wolves in their social structure and hunting habits, and can also be dangerous to other animals they encounter.

translations.source: Umgadli ophelele, ihlosi lingakhuphuka (yize lingakwazi kahle), libhukude, ligxume amabanga amade futhi lidonse ngamandla womuntu onamandla aphindwe kasihlanu.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: A complete sentence, the goal is to rise (though it may struggle), to overcome obstacles, to travel long distances, and to endure the strength of a person with extraordinary abilities.

translations.source: Ithayiga lisesigabeni esifanayo (Genus Panthera) njengamabhubesi, izingwe, kanye nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwazi ukubhonga.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The tiger belongs to the same genus (Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four species are the only ones capable of roaring.

translations.source: Ukubhonga kwehlosi akufani ncamashi nokubhonga kwengonyama, kodwa kucishe kufane nomusho wamagama entukuthelo, amenyezwayo.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: While the pursuit of a goal is certainly different from the roar of a lion, it is somewhat similar to the whispered words of passion, of longing.

translations.source: Ama-ocelots athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izimfene, izinyoka, izilwane eziququdayo kanye nezinyoni uma angakwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane ezizingelwa yilawa makati zincane kakhulu kunawo.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: Ocelots are carnivores that primarily eat small animals. They will catch rodents, snakes, marsupials, and birds when they can. Almost all of the animals that these cats prey on are smaller than themselves.

translations.source: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ama-ocelots alandelela futhi athola izilwane zokuzidla (izilwane ezizingelwayo) ngokunuka, efufuza lapho bezikhona phansi.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists believe that ocelots track and locate their prey (animals they hunt for food) using their sense of smell, sniffing out where the animals are hiding.

translations.source: Ayakwazi ukubona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngekhono lokubona ebusuku, abuye ahambe ngesinyenyela esikhulu, futhi. Ama-ocelot azingela izisulu zawo ngokuzifanisa nendawo akuyo bese agxumela izisulu zawo.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: It has excellent night vision, thanks to its nocturnal vision capabilities, and also possesses a long stride. Ocelots hunt their prey by camouflaging themselves within their environment and then ambushing their victims.

translations.source: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (inani elincane) lihlukana eqenjini elikhulu elisuka kulo (cishe lapho liya ngaphesheya kokhahlamba lwentaba noma umfula, noma uma liya esiqhingini esisha kangangokuba lingakwazi ukubuyela emuva kalula) ngokuvamile lizozithola endaweni ehlukile kunaleyo ebezikuyo ngaphambili.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small group of organisms (a small population) separates from a larger group (often by crossing a geographical barrier like a mountain range or river, or by colonizing a new island that is difficult to return from), they typically find themselves in a different environment than the one they previously inhabited.

translations.source: Le ndawo entsha inezinsizakusebenza ezihlukile nabancintisani abahlukene, ngakho-ke umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze ube ngabancintisani abaqinile kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambilini.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment has different features and various competitors, so the new community will need unique qualities or the ability to adapt in order to be strong competitors, more so than they needed to be before.

translations.source: Izidalwa ezazikhona zasekuqaleni azikashintshi, zisadinga indlela yokuphila efana neyangaphambili.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original creatures have not changed, and they still require a way of life that is similar to what they had before.

translations.source: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba iqembu elisha liqala ukujwayela indawo yalo entsha, liqala ukuya libukeka lingafani neqembu elinye.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as a new team settles into its environment, it begins to develop its own unique identity.

translations.source: Ekugcineni, ngemva kweminyaka eyizinkulungwane noma ngisho eyizigidi, amaqembu amabili azobukeka ehlukile kangangokuba angeke abizwe ngokuthi uhlobo olulodwa.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, after thousands or even millions of years, the two groups will become so different that they can no longer be considered the same species.

translations.source: Le nqubo siyibiza nge-speciation, okushe nje ukwakhekha kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Lokhu kwakheka umphumela ongakwemeki kanye nengxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: This process is called speciation, which essentially means the formation of new species. This development is an inevitable consequence and a crucial part of natural evolution.

translations.source: Izitshalo zenza i-oxygen leyo ephefumulwa abantu, futhi zithatha i-carbon-dioxide leyo ekhishwa abantu (okungukuthi, ukuphefumula ukhiphe umoya).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce the oxygen that humans breathe, and they absorb the carbon dioxide that humans exhale (that is, breathing releases carbon dioxide).

translations.source: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwazo nge-photosynthesis. Zibuye zenze nomthunzi.
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce their own food through photosynthesis. They also release oxygen.

translations.source: Senza izindlu zethu ngezitshalo futhi senza nezingubo ngezitshalo. Ukudla okuningi esikudlayo izitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane angeke ziqhubeke ziphila.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our homes using plants, and we also make clothes from plants. Many of the foods we eat come from plants. Without plants, animals would not be able to survive.

translations.source: I-mosasaurus bekuyisilwane esizingelayo esiyinhloko ngesikhathi sayo, ngakho-ke yayingesabi lutho, ngaphandle kwama-mosasaurus amanye.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The mosasaur was a dominant and formidable creature in its time, and therefore had few predators other than other mosasaurs.

translations.source: Imihlathi yayo emide eyayihlome ngamazinyo acijise okwensingo angaphezu kuka-70, kanye namanye engeziwe phezu komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho lutho esondela eduze kwayo eyayingaphunyuka.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: Its long, sharp teeth, numbering over 70, and the additional teeth on its upper jaw, meant that nothing could escape its grasp.

translations.source: Asazi ngokuqinisekile, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi yayinolimi olusamfoloko. Ukudla eyayikudla kuhlanganisa izimfudu, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ama-mosasaurus amanye, futhi kungenzeka nokuthi yayiyizimu.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: We are not entirely certain, but it is possible that it had a unique language. Its diet consisted of fish, large marine reptiles, other mosasaurs, and possibly even mammals.

translations.source: Yayibuye ihlasele noma yini engena emanzini; ngisho ne-dinosaur enkulu njenge-T.rex yayingeke ikwazi ukumelana nayo.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It could also neutralize anything that entered the water; even a large dinosaur like a T.rex wouldn't be able to withstand it.

translations.source: Ngenkathi iningi lokukudla kwabo kungaba okujwayelekile kuthina, amaRoma eyenesabelo sabo sezinto zemikhosi ezingajwayelekile, kubandakanya izingulube zasendle, ipigogo, iminenke, nohlobo lwegundane olubizwa nge-dormouse
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While much of their diet might seem ordinary to us, the Romans also had access to a variety of exotic foods, including wild boar, peacock, dormice, and a type of rodent called a dormouse.

translations.source: Omunye umehluko kwakuwukuthi nakuba abantu abampofu kanye nabesifazane babedla ukudla kwabo babe behlezi ezihlalweni, amadoda acebile ayethanda ukuba namadili ndawonye lapho ayehlala khona ngezinhlangothi kuyilapho edla ukudla kwawo.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: One key difference was that while the poor and women ate their meals while sitting, the wealthy men preferred to eat together in a communal area, often sitting side-by-side as they ate.

translations.source: Ukudla kwaseRoma yamandulo kwakungeke kuhlanganise ukudla okufike eYurophu kuvela eMelika noma kuvela e-Asia emakhulwini eminyaka alandelayo.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The cuisine of ancient Rome did not include foods that originated in the Americas or Asia, which were introduced to Europe centuries later.

translations.source: Ngokwesibonelo, babengenawo ummbila, noma otamatisi, noma amazambane, noma i-cocoa, futhi akekho umuntu waseRoma yamandulo oke wanambitha ikalikuni.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they had no spices, no tomatoes, no peppers, no cocoa, and no one in ancient Rome had ever tasted liquorice.

translations.source: AbaseBhabhiloni bakhela izithixo zabo ngazinye ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lesithixo.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a main temple for each of their gods, which was considered the god's dwelling place.

translations.source: Abantu abaletha imihlatshelo konkulunkulu nakubaphristi bazozama ukunika onkulunkulu izidingo zabo ngemigidi nemikhosi.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People who bring offerings to the gods or priests will try to communicate their needs to the gods through prayers and rituals.

translations.source: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke elivulekile lethempeli kanye nendawo engcwele ephakathi lapho kwakungena khona umphristi kuphela.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each temple had a main entrance and a sacred inner area that was accessible only to priests.

translations.source: Ngezinye izikhathi imibhoshongo ekhethekile engunxa-ntathu, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurat, yayakhiwe ukuze ibe ingxenye yamathempeli.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, special structures called ziggurats were built as part of temples.

translations.source: Isiqongo sombhoshongo kwakuyindawo engcwele ekhethekile yesithixo.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The sacred grove was a special place dedicated to the deity.
