translations.source: Esimweni sezulu esifudumele saseMpumalanga ePhakathi, indlu beyingabalulekanga kakhulu.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the hot, central regions of the East, housing is of utmost importance.

translations.source: Isikhathi esiningi impilo yemindeni yamaHebheru yenzeka endaweni evulekile.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Often, the lives of the Hebrew people unfolded in an open and exposed environment.

translations.source: Owesifazane wayepheka egcekeni, izitolo kwakungamatafula avulwayo abheke emgwaqweni. Amatshe ayesetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: The woman was cooking on a stove, and shops were lined up along the street. Stones were being used for construction.

translations.source: Ayengekho amahlathi amakhulu ezweni laseKhanani, ngakho izingodo zazibiza kakhulu.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so timber was very expensive.

translations.source: I-Greenland yayihlelwe kancane. E-Norse Segas bathi u-Erik the Red waboshwa e-Iceland ngenxa yokubulala, futhi lapho ehambela eNtshonalanga, wathola i-Greenland wase eyibiza ngokuthi i-Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland was initially explored by the Norse. According to Norse sagas, Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for manslaughter, and during his travels to the west, he discovered Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: Kodwa naphezu kokuba etholakele, isizwe sama-Eskiro besilokhu sihlala lapho ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: However, despite their discovery, the Eskimo people continued to live in that region at that time.

translations.source: Nakuba izwe ngalinye beliyi-‘Scandinavian’, bekunokungefani okuningi phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko, kanye nomlando wase-Denmark, e-Sweden, e-Norway kanye nase-Iceland.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Although all these countries were considered "Scandinavian," there were significant differences between the people, rulers, cultures, and histories of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Iceland.

translations.source: Uma wake wayibuka imovie i-National Treasure, ungafunga ukuthi ibalazwe lomcebo lalibhalwe ngemuva kweSimemezelo Sokuzimela.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you've ever seen the movie "National Treasure," you might think that the treasure map was hidden behind the Declaration of Independence.

translations.source: Noma kunjalo, lokho akulona iqiniso. Noma kunokuthile okubhalwe ngemuva kwencwadi, akuyona imephu eyigugu.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that is not the case. Even if something is written on the back of the book, it is not a valuable map.

translations.source: Okubhalwe ngemuva eNcazelweni Yokuzimela bekungamazwi “ENcazelo Yokuqala Yokuzimela yangomhlaka-4 kuNtulikazi 1776”. Umbhalo ovela ekugcineni kwencwadi, obheke phansi.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The inscription on the back of the Declaration of Independence reads: "The Declaration of Independence, July 4, 1776." This is the text found at the bottom of the document.

translations.source: Yize kungekho owaziyo ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ngubani oyibhalile, kuyaziwa ukuthi ekuqaleni kokuphila kwayo, idokhumenti enkulu yesikhumba (ilinganisa ama-intshi angu-29¾ ngamayintshi angu-24½) yayigoqwe ukuze igcinwe.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: Although it is not definitively known who wrote it, it is known that, in its early existence, the large leather-bound document (measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was created to be preserved.

translations.source: Ngakho-ke, cishe umcabango wafakwa njengophawu kalula.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the idea was easily adopted as a standard.

translations.source: Ukufika kwe-D-Day nezimpi ezilandelayo kwakukhulule inyakatho yeFrance, kodwa eningizimu kwakungakakhululeki.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The arrival of D-Day and the subsequent battles liberated northern France, but southern France remained under occupation.

translations.source: Yayibuswa amaFulentshi ase-“Vinchy”. Laba bekungabantu baseFulansi ababenze ukuthula neJalimane ngo-1940 futhi besebenzisana nabaphangi esikhundleni sokuthi balwe nabo.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: It was established by the French from "Vichy." These were French people who had made peace with Germany in 1940 and were collaborating with the enemy instead of fighting against them.

translations.source: Ngezi-15 kuNcwaba 1940, Izivunani zahlasela iningizimu France, futhi ukuhlasela kwabizwa “Umsebenzi Dragoon”.
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On December 15, 1940, the Allied forces attacked Southern France, and the operation was codenamed "Dragoon."

translations.source: Ngamasonto amabili nje amasosha ase-Melika kanye nawase-French Ekhululekile akhiphe iningizimu France ezingxoxweni zokuhweba futhi asephendukela eJalimane
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Just two weeks ago, American and French troops withdrew from southern France, ending their trade negotiations and turning their attention to Germany.

translations.source: Umphakathi wesintu isiko elilodwa elihlanganyelwa iqembu elikhulu labantu abahla futhi basebenze ndawonye, umphakathi.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: Culture is a system of customs, beliefs, and social institutions that are shared by a large group of people, a community.

translations.source: Igama elithi civilization lisuka egameni lesiLatin elithi civilis, okusho impucuko, elihlobene nelesiLatin elithi civis, elisho isakhamuzi, kanye nelithi civitas, elisho idolobha noma isifundazwe, futhi lokho ngenye indlela kubuye kuchaze ubukhulu bomphakathi.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word "civilization" originates from the Latin word "civilis," which means "relating to citizens" or "refined." This Latin word is related to "civis," meaning "citizen," and "civitas," meaning "city" or "state," and it also broadly refers to the development of society.

translations.source: Izifundazwe zandulela izizwe. Isiko lomphakathi lisho ukudlulisela ulwaze ezizukulwaneni eziningana, umkhondo ongokwesiko ohlala ukhona kanye nokusakazwa okuhle kokwaziswa.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: Provinces influence nations. Social customs involve the transmission of traditions across generations, a continuous cultural heritage, and the effective dissemination of information.

translations.source: Amasiko amancane ngokuvamile ayanyamalala ngaphandle kokushiya ubufakazi obungokomlando futhi ayahluleka ukuqashelwa njengemiphakathi yangempela.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Small cultures often disappear without leaving a historical trace and are often overlooked as distinct societies.

translations.source: Phakathi neMpi Yezinguqugo, izifunda eziyishumi nantathu zaqala zakha uhulumeni obuthakathaka—uKhongolose kuyisici sawo sodwa—ngaphansi kwe-Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the American Revolutionary War, the thirteen colonies established a weak central government—with Congress as its sole governing body—under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Ukhongolose wabe engenawo amandla okubeka intela, futhi, ngenxa yokuthi bokungekho sigungu sezwe noma noma isigungu sokwahlulela, uncike ezikhulwini zombuso, ezazingabambisani izikhathi ezingi, ukuphoqelela yonke imithetho yawo.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The president lacked the power to impose taxes, and, due to the absence of a national constitution or judicial system, relied on the decrees of the government, which were often inconsistent and could overturn all previous laws.

translations.source: Yayingenalo futhi igunya lokweqa imithetho yentela nokuthelisa ngempahla phakathi kwezifunda.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It did not have the authority to enforce tax laws or to seize property across different regions.

translations.source: Imithetho beyidinga ukuba zonke izifunda zivume ngaphambi kokuba ilungiswe futhi izifunda zithathe uhulumeni omkhulu njengongabalulekile kakhulu kangangokuba abameleli bazo babehlala bangekho.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The laws require the approval of all provinces before they can be amended, and the provinces hold significant power, to the extent that their representatives are often essential for the process.

translations.source: Ibhola lezinyawo lezwe laseNtaliyane, kanye neqembu lebhola lezinyawo lezwe laseJalimane iqembu lesibili eliphumelele kakhulu emhlabeni futhi bekuyizingqwele zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA ngo-2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: Italian football, along with the German football team, are two of the most successful national teams in the world and were both contenders in the 2006 FIFA World Cup.

translations.source: Imidlalo ethandwayo ihlanganisa ibhola lezinyawo, i-basketball, i-volleyball, ibhola lasemanzini, umngcweko, iragbhi, ukugibela amabhayisikili, ihoki yaseqhweni, ihoki evamile kanye nomncintiswano wezimoto zeF1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include soccer (football), basketball, volleyball, water polo, athletics (track and field), rugby, cycling, ice hockey, field hockey, and Formula 1 racing.

translations.source: Imidlalo yasebusika ithandwa kakhulu ezindaweni eziseNyakatho, lapho amaNtaliyane encintisana khona emidlalweni yamazwe onke kanye nasemidlalweni yama-Olimpiki.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: Winter sports are particularly popular in the northern regions, where athletes compete in national and international competitions, as well as the Olympic Games.

translations.source: IJapani ineziqhingi ezicishe zibe ngu-7000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke iHonshu), okwenza iJapani isiqhingi sesi-7 esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan has approximately 7,000 islands (with Honshu being the largest), making Japan the 7th largest island country in the world!

translations.source: Ngenxa yenqwaba/iqembu leziqhingi iJapani enazo, iJapani ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi, ngenxa yendawo ekuyo, njenge-"archipelago"
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to the large number of islands it comprises, Japan is often referred to, because of its geographical nature, as an "archipelago."

translations.source: Ukusungulwa kweTaiwan kuqala kudala ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka lapho amatilosi aseYurophu edlula ebhala igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: The history of Taiwan began long ago, in the 15th century, when European explorers sailed through the waters and named the island "Ilha Formosa," meaning "beautiful island."

translations.source: Ngo-1624, i-Dutch East India Company yamisa isikhungo eningizimu ntshonalanga Taiwan, iqalisa ukushintshwa kokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu komdabu futhi iqasha izisebenzi zaseShayina ukuba zisebenze emasimini welayisi noshukela.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a trading post in southwestern Taiwan, initiating the cultivation of sugar cane and employing Chinese laborers to work in the rice and sugarcane fields.

translations.source: Ngo-1683, amabutho obukhosi buka-Qing (1644-1912) athatha izindawo ezingasogwini ezisentshonalanga nasenyakatho ne-Taiwan futhi amisa i-Taiwan njengesifundazwe sombuso ka-Qing ngo-1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing dynasty's (1644-1912) forces took control of the western and northern parts of Taiwan and established Taiwan as a province of the Qing dynasty in 1885.

translations.source: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokuhlulwa eMpini Yokuqala yamaJapani yase—ino (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayina Isivumelwano se-Simonoseki, ngaso edlulisela iTaiwan eJapani, ebusa isiqhingi kuze kube ngu-1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: In 1895, following its defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan to Japan, which then ruled the island until 1945.

translations.source: IMachu Picchu yenziwa izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okungukuthi i-Intihuatana, i-Temple of the Sun, kanye ne-Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu is comprised of three main structures: the Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: Izakhiwo eziningi onqenqemeni lwendawo yokuhlala zakhiwe kabusha ukuzi zinikeze izivakashi umqondo ongcono wendlela ezazibukeka ngayo ekuqaleni.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the buildings in the historic district have been renovated to give visitors a better sense of what they looked like originally.

translations.source: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu weMachu Picchu ayebuyiselwe esimweni sasekuqaleni futhi ukubuyiselwa kusaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu was restored to its original condition, and the restoration work continues to this day.

translations.source: Ngokwesibonelo, indlela evamile kakhulu yohlobo lwesithombe emhlabeni ingu-35mm, ewubukhulu obufanayo nobefilimu ekupheleni kwesiqephu senkathi yamafilimu.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common focal length for camera lenses is 35mm, which is roughly equivalent to the field of view of the film used in the era of film cameras.

translations.source: Isenziwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubudlelwane bayo bobude nobukhulu buthathwe izimo zokuthungatha isithombe zekhamera yedijithali.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: While it still exists today, the most important thing is that the length and size of the lens are now determined by the image quality requirements of digital cameras.

translations.source: Ifomethi ka-35mm empeleni, ngodidayo ngokunye, ingu-36mm ububanzi kuphindwe ngo-24mm ubude.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: In reality, a 35mm format, specifically, has a width of 36mm multiplied by a length of 24mm.

translations.source: Isilinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni salefomethi (ukudivayida ngeshumi nambili ukuze uthole isilinganiso senombolo ephelele elula) ngakho-ke kuthiwa singu-3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The aspect ratio of this format (divided by twelve to obtain the ratio of the whole number) is therefore referred to as 3:2.

translations.source: Amafomethi amaningi avamile (iqoqo lamafomethi le-APS, ngokwesibonelo) ayalingana noma acishe alingane nalesi silinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Many common formats (such as the APS format, for example) have a width that is equal to or very close to this standard width.

translations.source: Lomthetho wezingxenye ezintathu esetshenziswa kabi kakhulu nonganakwa ngokuvamile isiqondiso esilula sokwenza ubuhle ube ugcina izinga lokuhleleka esithombeni.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: This rule of thirds, often misused, is essentially a simple guideline for creating visually appealing compositions and maintaining a sense of balance in an image.

translations.source: Ithi indawo ephumelela kakhulu ngesihloko esikhulu ilapho imigqa ihlangana khona ukuze ihlukanise isithombe kathathu ngokuqondile nangokuvundlile (bheka isibonelo).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: The most effective way to create a strong focal point is when lines converge to directly and clearly divide the image into three distinct sections (see example).

translations.source: Phakathi nalenkathi yomlando waseYurophu, iSonto lamaKatolika, elalicebile futhi linamandla, lahlolisiswa.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: During this period in European history, the Catholic Church, which was wealthy and powerful, came under scrutiny.

translations.source: Ngaphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane inkolo yobuKhristu yahlanganisa amazwe waseYurophu ndawonye ngaphezu kokuhluka kwezilimi namasiko.
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: For over a thousand years, Christianity has united the nations of Europe, transcending differences in language and culture.

translations.source: Amandla waso akuyo yonke indawo athinta wonke umuntu kusukela enkosini kuya emuntwini ovamile.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: Its influence permeates every aspect of society, affecting everyone from the chief to the ordinary person.

translations.source: Enye yemigomo eyinhloko yobuKristu ukuthi ingcebo kufanele isetshenziselwe ukudambisa ukuhlupheka nobuphofu nokuthi imali yebandla ilapho ngenxa yaleso sizathu.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the core principles of Christianity is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty, and that the church's resources should be used for that very purpose.

translations.source: Abaphathi abakhulu besonto babeseRoma iminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane futhi lokhu kuqoqana kwamandla nemali kwaholela abaningi ekusoleni ukuthi lomgomo wemfundiso uyafinyelelwa yini.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: For over a thousand years, the powerful leaders of the Church have been based in Rome, and this concentration of power and wealth has led many to question whether the Church's stated goals will ever be achieved.

translations.source: Ngokushesha ngemva kobutha, iBrithani yaqala ukuvimbezela iJalimane ngemikhumbi.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after the outbreak of war, Britain began to blockade Germany with its ships.

translations.source: Isu libonakale lisebenza, ukususwa kwezinto ezidingwa ibutho lamasosha nabantu abavamile, nakuba lokhu kuvimbela kuphule imithetho yamazwe wonke elungiswe izivumelwano zamazwe amaningana wamakhulu amabili eminyaka adlule.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The situation appears to be escalating, with the removal of essential supplies from both the military and civilian populations, despite the fact that these actions violate international laws established by treaties dating back over two centuries.

translations.source: I-Britain imba amanzi ezwekazi ukuze ivimbele imikhumbi ukuthi ingene kuyo yonke ingxenye yolwandle, okubangela izingozi ngisho nasemikhunjini evamile.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: Britain is deploying underwater barriers to prevent boats from entering certain areas of the sea, which poses risks even to ordinary vessels.

translations.source: Njengoba bekunokusabela okulinganiselwe kulendlela, iJalimane beyilindele ukusabela okufanayo empini yayo engavinjelwe yemikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Given the limited response to this request, Germany was anticipating a similar level of engagement in its ongoing, undeclared submarine warfare.

translations.source: Ngezikhathi zawo-1920, izimo zengqondo zezakhamuzi eziningi kanye nezizwe bezikholwa ukuzonda impi nokulwa kanye nokuzihlukanisa.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, many individuals and communities experienced a growing disillusionment with war, conflict, and division.

translations.source: Ngemva kokubona izenzo zonya nezishaqisayo zempi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, izizwe zafisa ukugwema isimo esinjalo futhi esikhathini esizayo.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: Following the devastating and horrific events of World War I, nations sought to avoid such a situation in the future.

translations.source: Ngo-1884 uTesla wathuthela eMelika ukwamukela umsebenzi neNkampani ka-Edison eDolobheni lase-New York.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla moved to America to accept a job with Edison's company in New York City.

translations.source: Ufike eMelika enamasenti angu-4 egameni lakhe, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye nencwadi yokutusa evela ku-Charles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe wasemsebenzini wakhe wangaphambili) iya kuThomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: He arrived in America with just $4 in his pocket, a book of poems, and a letter of introduction from Charles Batchelor (his former employer) addressed to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: IShayina yamandulo yayinendlela ehlukile yokuveza izinkathi ezihlukile; isigaba ngasinye seShayina noma umndeni ngamunye owawubusa wawuwubukhosi obuhlukile.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: The Chinese dynasties each had a distinct way of expressing themselves; each dynasty or ruling family had its own unique characteristics.

translations.source: Futhi phakathi kobukhosi ngabunye kwakuyiminyaka engazinzile yezifundazwe ezihlukene. Inkathi eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi kwakuyinkathi yemibuso emithathu eyenzeka iminyaka engama-60 phakathi koMbusokaHan noJin.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, within the empire itself, there were periods of instability and conflict between different regions. A particularly well-known period of this kind was the Three Kingdoms period, which lasted for about 60 years between the Han and Jin dynasties.

translations.source: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi kwakuba nezimpi ezinodlame phakathi kwababusi belwela ubukhosi.
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: During that time, there were brutal wars between chiefs vying for power.

translations.source: IMibuso Emithathu kwakungenye yenkathi yegazi eliningi kunazo zonke emlandweni waseShayina yakuDala, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kakhulu esigodlweni esihle e-Xi’an.
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The Three Kingdoms period was one of the bloodiest in Chinese history, with countless people dying in the struggle for power in the beautiful city of Xi'an.

translations.source: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo neyezepolitiki efana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulinganisa ngamamitha, ukusuka ekukholelweni ezimisweni eziphelele kuya ekusekeleni izimiso zoburiphabhuliki, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe elabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are numerous social and political consequences, such as the adoption of the metric system, a shift from belief in absolute principles to support for republicanism, nationalism, and the idea of a nation of people rather than a single ruler.

translations.source: Futhi ngemva kweNguquko izikhundla zazivulekele bonke abesilisa abafake izicelo okwavumela ukuthi abafuna ukuvelela kakhulu nokubahambela kahle baphumelele.
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: After the change, positions became open to all male applicants, which allowed those who were more determined and better prepared to succeed.

translations.source: Lokhu kufana nalokhu okwenzeka kumabutho amasosha kunokuba babheke inhlanga yakho bona bakhetha ukubeka i-cailaber ukuze banike amasosha ama-ratings.
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: This is similar to what happens in the military, where they assess your performance and then assign you a rating based on that assessment.

translations.source: INguquko kwaseFulansi kugqugquzele abanye abantu abasebenzayo abacindezelwe bakwamanye abazwe ukuthi baqale ukuvukela kwabo.
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution inspired some oppressed workers in other countries to begin their own uprisings.

translations.source: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esijulile ezindabeni zokuphila ezingaphathelene nezinto zalomhlaba. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi “iHira” eNtabeni “yeNoor” (ukukhanya) ukuze ayozindla.
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad had a deep interest in matters related to earthly life. He often used to go to a cave known as "Hira" on the mountain of "Noor" (light) to meditate.

translations.source: Umhume ngokwawo, obekhona kuze kube manje, unikeza isithombe esicacile sokuthambekela okungokomoya kukaMuhammad.
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, the existing accounts provide a clear picture of Muhammad's spiritual devotion.

translations.source: Umhume ohlezi phezu kwenye yezintaba zasenyakatho yase-Mecca, ukude kakhulu nomhlaba wonke.
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: A sacred stone, located atop one of the mountains in northern Mecca, holds great significance worldwide.

translations.source: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma wazi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni isuke isihlukaniswe ngokuphelele.
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In reality, it's not easy to find, even if you know it's there. Once it's inside the body, it becomes completely separated.

translations.source: Akukho okubonakalayo phezulu ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esibalele, esihle kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu okwalelizwe okubonakalayo noma okuzwakalayo uma uphakathi emgedeni.
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: There is nothing visible above except for the vast, beautiful sky and the many mountains that surround it. There is very little of the outside world that can be seen or heard when you are inside the cave.

translations.source: I-Great Pyramid yase-Giza iyokuphela kwizimangaliso eziyisikhombisa esamile nanamuhla.
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza remains one of the few remaining wonders of the ancient world.

translations.source: Yakhiwe ngabaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu leminyaka BCE, I-Great Pyramide, ngelinye lezakhiwo zamaphiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of the pyramids constructed to honor a deceased pharaoh.

translations.source: I-Giza Plateau, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" eSigodini sabaFile saseGibhithe linemibhoshongo emingxa-ntathu eminingana (leyo umbhoshongo omkhulu kuyiwo omkhulu kakhulu), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: The Giza Plateau, also known as the "Giza Necropolis" in Egypt, contains several large pyramids (the largest of which is the Great Pyramid), several smaller tombs, several temples, and the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: Umbhoshongo omkhulu ongunxa-ntathu wakhelwa ukuhlonipha uFaro uKhufu, futhi neminye imibhoshongo engunxa-ntathu emincanyana, amathuna, kanye namathempeli akhelwe ukuhlonipha inkosikazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni.
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The largest pyramid was built to honor Pharaoh Khufu, and several smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were also constructed to honor Khufu's wife and family members.

translations.source: Uphawu "lomnsalo ophezulu" olubukeka njengo-V kanti "uphawu lomnsalo ophansi" lubukeka njengesigaxa noma isikwele esishoda ngohlangothi lwaso olungaphansi.
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "upper glyph" resembles a "V", while the "lower glyph" looks like a triangle or a wedge with its bottom edge sloping downwards.

translations.source: Phezulu kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale ekugcineni bese uphusha umnsalo, kanti phansi kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale exoxweni (okusho ukuthi lapho ubambe khona umnsalo) bese ugobisa umcibisholo.
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: "Phezulu" means you should start at the end and pull the thread, while "phansi" means you should start at the beginning (where you hold the thread) and push the needle.

translations.source: Umnsalo ophezulu ujwayele ukwenza umsindo opholile, kanti umnsalo ophansi wenza umsindo onamandla noqinile kakhudlwana.
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: Generally, a higher pitch produces a softer sound, while a lower pitch produces a louder and more resonant sound.

translations.source: Zizwe ukhululekile ukubhala izimpawu zakho ngepensela, kepha khumbula izimpawu eziphrintiwe ezehlayo zikhona ngesizathu esingokomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlonishwe.
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: You are free to write in your answers using a pencil, but remember that the printed notes on the page are there for a reason, so they should be respected.

translations.source: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 kuMfumfu 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: On August 6, 1789, King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette, and their two young children (Marie Therese, aged 11, and Louis-Charles, aged 4), along with the King's sister, Princess Elizabeth, were forced to return to Paris from Versailles by a crowd of women from the marketplace.

translations.source: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: They were in a state of distress, returning from the Pharisees, surrounded by a large crowd of people who were shouting insults and accusations against the Lord and the Queen.

translations.source: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.hypothesis: The crowd of people urged the King and Queen to open the windows of their car.

translations.source: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.hypothesis: There was a time when a member of the guard wanted to desecrate the head of the executed court official, which had been displayed in Versailles, in front of the horrified Queen.

translations.source: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.hypothesis: The costs of the American colonial wars, including the conquest of the Philippines, were largely borne by the people of the Philippines themselves.

translations.source: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.hypothesis: The American colonial government forced them to pay taxes, covering a significant portion of the costs, while the profits from the sugar plantations were deposited in the name of the Philippine government in Wall Street banks.

translations.source: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.hypothesis: Clearly, the significant benefits gained from the continuous exploitation of the Filipino people have served to strengthen the core interests of the United States.

translations.source: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.hypothesis: To understand the Templars, one must understand the ideology that created this organization.

translations.source: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: The period often referred to as the High Middle Ages is a period in European history that spans the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (approximately 1000–1300 AD).

translations.source: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: The High Middle Ages followed the Early Middle Ages and was succeeded by the Late Middle Ages, typically ending around 1500.

translations.source: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: The concept of technological determinism encompasses a range of ideas, from the simple use of existing technologies to the belief that technology drives societal change, and even to the strong assertion that cultural development is fundamentally shaped by a deep understanding of scientific principles and their technological applications.

translations.source: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "nemithelela" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Many definitions of technological determinism share two common ideas: that technological development follows a path largely independent of social or political forces, and that technology itself "shapes" societies more than social structures shape technology.

translations.source: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, someone might say that a car contributes to the construction of roads.

translations.source: Nokho, imigwaqo exhumanisa izwe lonke ayizuzisi ngokomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje kuphela, ngakho izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ziyenziwa ukunciphisa inani lokuba nemoto.
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: However, the roads that crisscross the country primarily benefit a small number of vehicles, so new production methods are being developed to reduce the cost of owning a car.

translations.source: Ukuba nezimoto kwabantu abaningi nakho kuholela ezigamekweni eziphakeme zezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekusungulweni kwezindlela ezintsha kwezempilo zokulungisa imizimba elimele.
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: The increasing number of vehicles on the road has also led to a rise in traffic accidents, which in turn has resulted in the development of new medical procedures for treating injuries.

translations.source: I-Romanticism  yabanomthelela omkhulu ezinkolelweni zokuziphatha zamasiko, okuthathelwa kubabhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, kanye noSchlegel.
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Romanticism had a significant influence on cultural ethical theories, particularly on writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.

translations.source: Esizindeni seRomanticism, indawo ibumba abantu ngabanye, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imikhuba nesiko ehlobene naleyo ndawo yavela, futhi lena, ivumelana nendawo yomphakathi, yayingcono kunemithetho emiswe ngokunganaki.
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: During the Romantic era, a sense of community formed among people, and over time, customs and traditions associated with that community emerged. This, in alignment with the social environment, proved to be more effective than arbitrary rules.

translations.source: Ngendlela iParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yezwe lamanje, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yezikhonzi zaseYurophu.
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: While Paris is known as the capital of the modern world, Constantinople was regarded as the capital of the European empires.

translations.source: Yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yalapho kwaqala khona izinto zikanokusho cishe ngo-400 A.D. futhi yahlala cishe kwaze kaba u-1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: It is known as a region where spices were first cultivated, starting around 400 A.D., and this practice continued until approximately 1100 A.D.

translations.source: Isimo sayo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leminyaka leshumi nambili ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yokuthi Abalweli Benkolo babebuye bephethe izipho ezinjengosilika nezinongo ezaziyigugu kunalezo imakethe yaseByzantium eyayinazo.
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: Its decline began in the 12th century, primarily because the Crusaders were bringing back luxury goods like silk and spices that were more valuable than those available in the Byzantine market.

translations.source: Kwakungalesi sikhathi lapho ukudluliselwa kwesiqu seNhlokodolobha yeMfashini kusuka eKhonstantinopheli kuya ePherisi kwenziwa.
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: It was during this time that the transfer of the relics of the city of Florence was carried out, moving them from Constantinople to Pienza.

translations.source: Isitayela se-Gothic safinyelela umvuthwandaba enkathini ephakathi kwekhulu le-10 - 11 nekhulu le-14.
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: The Gothic style reached its peak popularity during the 10th-11th centuries and the 14th century.

translations.source: Ekuqaleni ukwembatha kwakuthonywe kakhulu isiko laseByzantium empumalanga.
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the art of warfare was heavily influenced by Byzantine traditions in the east.

translations.source: Noma kunjalo, ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izitayela zasentshonalanga zingasalela emuva ngeminyaka ewu-25 ukuya kwengu-30.
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to the lack of communication channels, Western trends can sometimes lag behind by 25 to 30 years.

translations.source: Ngasekupheleni kweNkathi Ephakathi intshonalanga Yurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yentuthuko enkulu kakhulu yaleso sikhathi ngenxa yabalweli benkolo abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukubopha izimpahla zokugqoka.
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: Towards the end of the Middle Ages, Western Europe began to develop its own distinct style. One of the most significant developments of that era was that, due to the influence of religious figures, people started using buttons to fasten their clothing.

translations.source: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa ukulima okwenzelwa ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomlimi kanye nomdeni wakhe kuphela.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming is the practice of growing food primarily to meet the needs of the farmer and their family, rather than for commercial purposes.

translations.source: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa indlela elula, ngovamile okususelwe ezintweni eziphilayo, kusetshenziswa imbewu egciniwe yasendaweni enezici ezingokwemvelo kuhlanganiswe nokushintshashintsha izilimo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula zokwenza umkhiqizo ube mningi.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Sustainable agriculture, a common approach based on living systems, utilizes locally adapted, preserved seeds and incorporates crop rotation or other environmentally friendly methods to increase productivity.

translations.source: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, many farmers have cultivated crops for their own sustenance, and this practice continues to be prevalent in many developing countries.

translations.source: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: Different groups bring together people who feel marginalized by societal norms and allow them to build a sense of community and belonging.

translations.source: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: Cultural differences can arise due to factors such as age, ethnicity, background, location, and/or gender of individuals.

translations.source: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: The characteristics that define a group as a distinct cultural entity can include language, aesthetics, religion, politics, gender, location, or a combination of these factors.

translations.source: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of a subculture often express their belonging to that group through a distinct style that represents something specific, encompassing fashion, behavior, and even the way they speak.

translations.source: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the many common factors that contribute to the importance of healthy relationships and close bonds in children is that, unfortunately, through neglect, or even abuse, some children may become overly attached to adults during their development.

translations.source: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: Children like these are often referred to as "differently-abled" or "special needs." Some differently-abled children are cared for by others (usually their parents); in some cases, this separation of the child from their family may be due to the parent's inability to cope with the child's significant intellectual or physical disabilities.

translations.source: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: Children who are victims of domestic violence may experience severe emotional trauma or distress, potentially leading to them being abandoned or running away.

translations.source: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Some are said to be raised by humans; others are said to live in the wild on their own.

translations.source: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: When a non-human animal is raised in isolation, the resulting offspring often exhibits behaviors that are remarkably similar to those of the animal that cared for it, such as fear or indifference towards humans.

translations.source: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While project-based learning aims to make learning easier and more engaging, gamification takes it a step further.

translations.source: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Scaffolding is not a method of teaching, but rather a support system that provides assistance to individuals who are learning something new, such as using a new computer program or starting a new project.

translations.source: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Scaffolds can be either digital or physical. In other words, a teacher is a type of scaffold, but so is a small device used for assembling paper, like a Microsoft Office application.

translations.source: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: Computer modules are integrated within the curriculum and are designed to guide, prompt, and explain processes that students might find challenging to complete on their own.

translations.source: Izingane zigcinwa emakhaya anakekela abantwana ngezizathu eziningi njengokukhishwa inyumbazane, ukuhlukunyezwa kanye nokuphamba.
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children are placed in foster care for various reasons, such as parental substance abuse, neglect, and abandonment.

translations.source: Kayikho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engalungile, engenalo uthando, engenankathalo kanye nemfundo, kodwa kuyenzeka.
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: No child should be forced to grow up in an environment that is harmful, lacking in love, care, and education, but unfortunately, it does happen.

translations.source: Sibona i-Foster Care System iyindawo yokuphepha yalezi zingane.
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We see the foster care system as a safe haven for these children.

translations.source: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: Our process for finding homes for children without parents must provide for safe and stable environments, loving caregivers, consistent education, and reliable healthcare.

translations.source: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: A foster home should provide for the needs that the child was not able to have in their previous home.

translations.source: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: The internet combines various communication and collaboration features.

translations.source: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: The unique features of the internet have led to increased scrutiny regarding its usage and user satisfaction.

translations.source: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, "education" and "social integration" are considered important factors in promoting internet usage (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: “Ukuzibandakanya komuntu siqu” kanye “nobudlelwano obuqhubekayo” kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zokugqugquzela ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.hypothesis: "Personal involvement" and "ongoing relationship" were identified as new drivers of engagement by Eighmey and McCord (1998) in their study of how website visitors respond.

translations.source: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: The use of video analysis has led to significant advancements in the detection of subtle expressions, including facial movements that occur in fractions of a second.

translations.source: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: Specifically, it is said that one can tell if someone is lying by carefully observing subtle changes in their facial expressions.

translations.source: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, ubonise ukuthi abantu abangakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: In his presidential address, Oliver Sacks pointed out that individuals who are unable to comprehend speech due to brain damage are often able to perceive sincerity directly.

translations.source: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha komuntu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, we should consider whether such skills in understanding and interpreting human behavior could be applied to animals, such as domestic dogs.

translations.source: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhlukana kofuzo: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: Over the past two decades, research has shown that there are two types of genetic segregation: hidden and overt.

translations.source: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: Mutation creates new genetic variations, while selection eliminates existing variations.

translations.source: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The gap between the rates of separation and combination of families has increased significantly between each generation.

translations.source: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: Outside of forests, it is difficult for animals with digestive systems similar to humans to meet their amino acid requirements using only available plants.

translations.source: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, failing to do so has very serious consequences: stunted growth, malnutrition, and ultimately, death.

translations.source: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: Plant-based protein sources are readily available, found in things like nuts and seeds, but these can be difficult to digest in their raw form.

translations.source: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: In contrast, animal products (meat, fish, eggs) are not only easily digestible but also provide high-quality protein containing all the essential amino acids.

translations.source: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumele simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: Once all the factors are considered, it's not surprising that our ancestors resolved their "protein problem" in a way that is remarkably similar to how wealthy people address it today.

translations.source: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Sleep apnea is a condition in which breathing repeatedly stops and starts during sleep, typically occurring multiple times per hour.

translations.source: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can be easily done using a spirit level, which will tilt downwards when it is not perfectly level, thus indicating the direction you need to adjust.

translations.source: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you find yourself setting an alarm and then falling back asleep, consider placing it on the other side of the room. This will force you to get out of bed to turn it off.

translations.source: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: Other methods based on natural cycles include drinking a large amount of liquid (especially water or tea, a well-known diuretic) before going to bed, which encourages the person to wake up and urinate.

translations.source: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: The level of inner peace a person experiences is directly related to the amount of stress they have, both physically and emotionally.

translations.source: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: When pressure is at its lowest, that's when the power of life truly shines. Everyone has the potential to find complete peace and fulfillment.

translations.source: Wonke umuntu angazuza ukukhanyiselwa. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone can benefit from enlightenment. The only things standing in the way of achieving this goal are mental obstacles and prejudice.

translations.source: I-Tibetan Buddhism isekelwe  ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddhism, but it has been expanded through the Mahayana tradition and incorporates many practices derived from Indian Yoga.

translations.source: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: Essentially, Tibetan Buddhism is quite simple. It encompasses Kundalini Yoga, meditation, and a path of unconditional love.

translations.source: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: In Kundalini Yoga, the Kundalini energy (also known as the energy of illumination) is awakened through specific yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras, and visualization techniques.

translations.source: Isikhungo sokuzindla kweTibet yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The Tibetan center for spiritual practice is Deity Yoga. Through visualization, various deities and energy pathways are purified, the chakras are activated, and a connection to the divine is established.

translations.source: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: Germany was a key factor in World War II, leading to the involvement of the USSR and the United States. The conflict, driven by ideological, political, and cultural differences, ultimately pitted these powerful nations against each other.

translations.source: Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yempi, ababeyimifela ndawonye empini manje sebeyizitha futhi sebeqalise Impi Ebandayo.
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: After two years of war, the former allies who fought together are now enemies and have begun a devastating conflict.

translations.source: Kwakufanele ihlale iminyaka engu-40 elandelayo futhi kulwe kuyo ngokoqobo, amabutho abambele, ezinkundleni zempi kusukela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba kanye nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
