translations.hypothesis: It was to last for the next 40 years and be fought over fiercely, with armies clashing, battlefields shifting from Africa to Asia, Afghanistan, Cuba, and many other places.

translations.source: NgoMandulo 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: On September 17, 1939, the Polish forces were already under attack, and the last glimmer of hope lay in a potential withdrawal and reorganization near the Romanian border.

translations.source: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka eSoviet's Union Red Army angena futhi akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: However, these plans were quickly overtaken by events. In a single night, over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet Union's Red Army invaded and occupied Belarus and Ukraine, following an attack on eastern Poland that violated the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international peace agreements, both bilateral and multilateral.

translations.source: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: Using ships to transport goods is a highly effective method for moving large quantities of people and cargo across oceans.

translations.source: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: The primary function of logistics is typically to ensure that your country maintains the ability to transport its people and goods, while simultaneously disrupting the ability of your enemy to transport their people and goods.

translations.source: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most notable recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of World War II. The Americans were attempting to transport people and goods across the Atlantic Ocean to aid Britain.

translations.source: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, the German navy, primarily using U-boats, was attempting to disrupt this trade.

translations.source: Ukube ama-Allies ehlulekile, iJalimane cishe ibizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: If the Allies had failed, Germany would likely have been able to conquer Britain, just as it had conquered the rest of Europe.

translations.source: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: It appears that domestication of animals, specifically sheep, likely began around 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: Amasiko nezizwana zasemandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyama, kanye nesikhumba.
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: Traditional customs and practices initially served as a simple way to obtain resources like beer, eggs, meat, and hides.

translations.source: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lezi zindlela sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: Cattle were typically kept in herds that grazed in pastures or open areas, and were regularly milked by herders, who were often young people or adolescents. These traditional methods of herding and milking are still used today.

translations.source: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: Roads for carriages were built in England starting in the 16th century.

translations.source: Nakuba imizila yezinqola beyenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: While bicycle paths are often built on relatively smooth surfaces, they allow cyclists to reach higher speeds and carry lighter loads compared to rougher, more uneven roads.

translations.source: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the design of these tools was focused on maximizing the cutting edge. However, over time, it became apparent that the tool could perform better if it had a thicker steel body.

translations.source: Lokhu kwaba inqubo evamile, kodwa insimbi yayihlikihla amasondo okhuni wezinqola.
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: This was a standard procedure, but the drill was jamming the wooden wheels of the carts.

translations.source: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, ujantshi wokuqala wensimbi ophelele waqala ukusetshenziswa.
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first fully functional iron wheel was put into use.

translations.source: Indlela yokuqala yokuthatha uhambo eyaziwayo ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kwe-Homo Erectus (okusho umuntu ome waqonda).
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: One of the earliest and most well-known forms of travel is walking. Humans began walking upright approximately two million years ago, with the emergence of Homo Erectus (which translates to "upright man").

translations.source: Ababalandela esikhundleni, ama-Australopithecus bawangahambi ngendlela yokuma aqonde ngokujwayelekile.
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike their upright-walking descendants, australopithecines typically walked on all fours.

translations.source: Okuchwepheshe ngokuba nyawo-mbili kutholakala emathanjeni aguquke itshe we-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba ama-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ayehamba ngezinyawo ezimbili ngaphambili kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: Evidence of bipedalism (walking on two legs) has been found in the fossil record of Australopithecus, dating back 4.2 to 3.9 million years ago. However, it is possible that Sahelanthropus also walked upright even earlier, perhaps as far back as 7 million years ago.

translations.source: Singaqala ukuphila ngobungane kakhulu nemvelo, singajoyina inhlangano yezemvelo, futhi singaba ngisho izishoshovu ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka okuzayo ngezinga elithile.
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can start living more harmoniously with nature by joining environmental organizations and even becoming activists to reduce future suffering to some extent.

translations.source: Kufana nekhambi nje lokwelapha izimpawu zokugula ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni isisombululo sesikhashana, kumele sithole umsuka wenkinga bese sinqanda wona.
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.hypothesis: It's like a medicine that only treats the symptoms of a disease, without addressing the underlying cause. However, if we don't want a temporary solution, we need to find the root of the problem and eliminate it.

translations.source: Kusobala ngokwanele ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokuthuthuka kwabantu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga zibe zinkulu ngenxa yokugcwala kwabantu kanye nempilo yesintu nokuphila kwesintu okuwubukhazikhazi.
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.hypothesis: It is clear that the world has changed significantly due to human advancements in science and technology, and these changes have led to greater challenges, particularly due to overpopulation and the erosion of traditional cultures and ways of life.

translations.source: Ngemva kokwamukelwa uKhongolose ngoNtulikazi 4, isiphakamiso esibhalwe ngesandla sasayinwa uMongameli kaKhongolose uJohn Hancock futhi noNobhala uCharles Thompson wathunyelwa esitolo esiseduzane sokuphrinta sikaJohn Dunlap.
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: Following its adoption on July 4th, the handwritten draft of the Declaration was signed by President John Hancock and Secretary Charles Thompson, and then sent to a nearby printing shop owned by John Dunlap.

translations.source: Phakathi nobusuku kwenziwa amakhophi aphakathi kuka-150 no-200, manje aziwa ngokuthi “iDunlap broadsides”.
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.hypothesis: During the night, between 150 and 200 copies were printed, which are now known as the "Dunlap broadsides."

translations.source: Ukufundwa kwedokhumenti kokuqala kwenziwa uJohn Nixon enkundleni ye-Independence Hall ngoNtulikazi 8.
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.hypothesis: The initial reading of the document took place by John Nixon in the Independence Hall on August 8th.

translations.source: Eyodwa yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoNtulikazi 6, owenza ukuba ifundwelwe amabutho akhe eNew York ngoNtulikazi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngoNcwaba 10.
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.hypothesis: One was sent to George Washington on July 6th, causing it to be read to his troops in New York on July 9th. A copy arrived in London on February 10th.

translations.source: Ububanzi be-Dunlap 25 okwaziwa ukuthi kukhona amakhophi wedokhumenti akhona amadala kunawo wonke. Ikhophi yasekuqaleni ebhalwe ngesandla ayisekho.
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.hypothesis: The Dunlap 25, known to contain the oldest known copies of the document, has copies that are older than all others. The original handwritten copy is no longer available.

translations.source: Izazi eziningi zesayensi yemivubukulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur laqhubeka liphila futhi lisaphila namuhla. Siwabiza ngezinyoni.
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.hypothesis: Many modern scientists in the field of paleontology believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and continues to exist today. We call them birds.

translations.source: Abantu abaningi abazithathi njengama-dinosaur ngoba zinezimpaphe futhi ziyakwazi ukundiza.
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.hypothesis: Many people mistakenly think of dinosaurs as having feathers and being able to fly.

translations.source: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ngezinyoni ezisafana ne-dinosaur.
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: However, there are many things about birds that are similar to dinosaurs.

translations.source: Zinezinyawo ezinocwecwe nezinzipho, zibekela amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo ezimbili zasemuva njengeT-Rex.
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: They have scaly legs and claws, lay eggs, and walk on their two hind legs, much like a T-Rex.

translations.source: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswayo namuhla asekelwe ekusebenziseni ukwaziswa okufakwayo endaweni ngezinombolo ezibhangqiwe.
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the computers used today are based on the principle of using integrated circuits, which are essentially complex networks of interconnected components.

translations.source: Inombolo enziwe ngeziqu ezimbili ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela kulawa amabili, okungukuthi u-0 noma u-1, futhi kubhekiselwa kulezinombolo ngokuthi amadijithi aneziqu ezimbili - noma ama-bit, ukusebenzisa ijagoni yekhompyutha.
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.hypothesis: A binary number is composed of two digits, and each of these digits can only have one of two values: 0 or 1. These digits, with only two possible values, are referred to as binary digits or bits, and they are the fundamental units of information used in computer systems.

translations.source: Ubuthi bangaphakathi kungezeka bungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, njengokuhlanza zanele ngokuvamile kangangokuthi umhlahlo wokushesha angeke wenziwe.
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.hypothesis: Internal bleeding may not always be immediately apparent. The symptoms, such as mild bruising, can often be so subtle that a quick examination might not reveal the problem.

translations.source: Isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu soshevu ovela ngaphakathi kungaba ukuba khona kwezitsha zemithi ezivulekile noma amakhemikhali wasendlini anobuthi.
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.hypothesis: A strong indicator of potential indoor air pollution could be the presence of open containers of wood products or household chemicals containing volatile compounds.

translations.source: Bheka ilebula ukuze ubone iziqondiso soziso lokuqala zalowo shevu.
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.hypothesis: Check the label to see the initial warning instructions for that product.

translations.source: Igama elithi isilwanyakazane lisetshenziswa izazi zezinambuzane ngendlela esemthethweni yaleli qembu lezi zinambuzane.
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.hypothesis: The term "wasp" is used by entomologists as the formal name for this group of insects.

translations.source: Leli gama lidabuka ekujwayelaneni kwakudala neziMbungulu, okuyizilwanyana ezizifanelisela ngokuphila ngokudla emzimbeni wabantu.
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.hypothesis: This term originates from ancient customs involving ticks, which are parasites that live by feeding on the bodies of humans and animals.

translations.source: Zombili iZimbungulu eziphila ngezinye izinambuzane neZimbungulu ezivamile zihlala esidlekeni, zifanelekele ukuhlala esidlekeni noma ezindlini zabasingathi bazo.
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.hypothesis: Two species of armadillo that feed on insects and common armadillos live in burrows, making them suitable for living in gardens or in enclosures built by their owners.

translations.source: EMelika yonke kunesilinganiso sabantu abawu-400,000 okubikwe ukuthi bane-Multiple Sclerosis(MS), okusishiya njengesifo esihamba phambili semizwa kubantu abadala abasebasha naphakathi.
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.hypothesis: Across the United States, an estimated 400,000 people have been diagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis (MS), making it a leading neurological disease affecting young and middle-aged adults.

translations.source: I-MS isifo esithinta uhlelo lwezinzwa, olwenziwa ubuchopho, umfunkulu kanye nenzwa yokubona.
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.hypothesis: MS (Multiple Sclerosis) is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which includes the brain, spinal cord, and optic nerves.

translations.source: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi abesifazane banamathuba akabili okuba neMS kunabesilisa.
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.hypothesis: Research has shown that women are twice as likely to develop multiple sclerosis as men.

translations.source: Abantu ababili abathandanayo bangabona kungenakubasiza, noma kusize ingane yawo, ukukhulisa ingane.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.hypothesis: Two people who love each other may realize that, whether it helps them or their child, raising a child is not for them.

translations.source: Le mibhangqwana ingakhetha ukwenza uhlelo lokuthi ingane yabo itholwe abanye.
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.hypothesis: These couples may choose to arrange for their child to be raised by others.

translations.source: Endabeni yokutholwa, abazali abazizalayo banqamula amalungelo abo okuba abazali ukuze omunye umbhangqwana ube umzali wengane.
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.hypothesis: In the context of adoption, biological parents relinquish their parental rights so that another couple can become the child's legal parents.

translations.source: Umngomo oyinhloko wesayensi ukuthola indlela izwe elisebenza ngayo uma lisebenzisa indlela yesayensi. Le ndlela eqinisweni iqondisa oluningi ucwaningo lwesayensi.
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: The primary goal of science is to understand how the world works by using the scientific method. This method actually guides much of scientific research.

translations.source: Akukodwa nokho, ukulinga, futhi isilingo isivivinyo esisetshenziselwa ukususa ukucabangela okuhle okukodwa noma okwengeziwe, ukubuza imibuzo, nokwenza ukuphawula kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo olungokwesayensi.
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: However, skepticism, and doubt are essential tools used to challenge assumptions, ask critical questions, and guide scientific inquiry.

translations.source: Izazi zemvelo kanye nezefilosofi zigxile emibhalweni yamandulo futhi, ngokukhethekile, eBhayibhelini ngesiLatin.
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Experts in environmental science and philosophy have focused on ancient texts, and particularly on the Bible in its original Latin form.

translations.source: Imibono ka-Aristotle yesayensi yamukelwa yonke, kuhlanganise nesayikholoji.
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle's views on science were widely accepted, including his views on psychology.

translations.source: Njengoba ulwazi lwaseGrisi lwaluncipha, iNtshonalanga yazithola isuka ezimpandeni zayo zefilosofi nesayensi zobuGriki.
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.hypothesis: As Greek knowledge declined, the West found itself drawing upon the philosophical and scientific traditions of ancient Greece.

translations.source: Iningi lokuphindaphinda kuyifiziyoloji nasekuziphatheni okubonwayo ngokuvamile kuxhomeke ngokuyinhloko ekubeni khona kwemijikelezo evela phakathi kanye nokwenziwa kwako ngamawashi emvelo.
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.hypothesis: Most recurring patterns in nature, whether physical or behavioral, are primarily determined by the presence of cycles originating from within and shaped by environmental factors.

translations.source: Izigqi zezikhathi ezithile, okungekhona ukusabela nje kwezinkomba ezingaphandle, kubikiwe ezidalweni eziningi eziphilayo, kuhlanganise amabhakithiliya, isikhunta, izitshalo, kanye nezilwane.
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.hypothesis: Certain environmental factors, not just responses to external stimuli, have been shown to influence the development of various living organisms, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

translations.source: Amawashi endalo azivuselela amandla azoqhubeka esebenza emjikelwezweni okhululekile ngisho noma enkathini ongeke ukwazi ukuyicabanga.
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.hypothesis: Natural resources replenish themselves and continue to function within a balanced ecosystem, even in conditions that might seem unimaginable.

translations.source: Ukuhlolwa kuka-Hershey no-Chase bekungokunye kokusikisela okuhamba phampili kokuthi iDNA isakhi sofuzo.
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the key pieces of evidence that supported the idea that DNA is the genetic material.

translations.source: UHershey noChase basebenzisa ama-phages, noma amagciwane, ukuze bafake i-DNA yabo ku-bacterium.
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to insert their DNA into bacteria.

translations.source: Benze ukuhlola ezimbili ngokwenza i-DNA nge-phage besebenzisa iphosphorus ye-radioactive noma amaprotheni e-phage nge-sulfur ye-radioactive.
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.hypothesis: They conducted two types of experiments: one by using radioactive phosphorus to label the DNA, and another by using radioactive sulfur to label the phage proteins.

translations.source: Ukuguquka kungaba namathonya ahlukile angafani kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka, ukubaluleka kocezu lwesakhi sofuzo oluthintekile kanye nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile amangqamuzana esidoda neqanda yini.
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.hypothesis: Mutations can have different characteristics depending on the type of mutation, the importance of the affected gene sequence, and whether the affected genes are sex-linked (found on the sex chromosomes).

translations.source: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo emagqamuzaneni wamagciwane kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, nakuba ukuguquka kwenye indawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.hypothesis: Only mutations in the genes that control bacterial virulence can be passed on to offspring, although mutations in other areas can cause the bacteria to die or become cancerous.

translations.source: Izindawo zokuvakasha ezingokwemvelo zikhanga abantu abathanda ukuvakashela izindawo ezingokwemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela ukubuka indawo, kuhlanganise izitshalo nezilwane zasendle.
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Natural tourist destinations attract people who enjoy visiting natural areas to appreciate the scenery, including the plants and animals that live there.

translations.source: Izibonelo zemisebenzi eyenziwa endaweni zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki nokufunda ukwaziswa okumayelana nezinto eziphilayo.
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.hypothesis: Examples of activities that can be enjoyed in these areas include hiking, fishing, photography, birdwatching, and visiting parks to learn about the local flora and fauna.

translations.source: Isibonelo ukuvakasha, ukuthatha izithombe, kanye nokufunda ngama-orangatan eBorneo.
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: For example, you could visit, take photos, and learn about orangutans in Borneo.

translations.source: Njalo ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane wasemaphandleni ngezimoto ukuze baye ezindaweni zabo zokusebenzela futhi badlulwa abanye indawo yabo yokusebenzela elapho basanda kusuka khona.
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.hypothesis: Every morning, people leave the small rural towns in their cars to go to their workplaces, often passing by the very places where they live on their way.

translations.source: Kuloluhlobo lwesithuthi olunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlelathile uxhumene, futhi usekela uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni ezincane.
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.hypothesis: This type of transportation system is highly efficient because it connects people directly and supports a transportation network based on smaller vehicles.

translations.source: Isayensi manje ikhomba ukuthi lokhu kubakhona kwe-carbon kucekele phansi imvelo kusuka kwesinye sezimo sayo esizinzile kakhulu esisekele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.hypothesis: Science now indicates that this increase in carbon levels is disrupting the environment, moving it away from one of its most stable states, a state that has supported human development for the past two million years.

translations.source: Wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela emphakathini futhi usebenzisa uhlelo lokuthutha. Cishe wonke umuntu uyakhalaza ngohlelo lokuthutha.
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone participates in the community and uses the transportation system. Almost everyone is complaining about the transportation system.

translations.source: Emazweni athuthukile uyethukela uzwa amazinga afanayo okukhalaza ngekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awayo.
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.hypothesis: In developed countries, you often hear similar complaints about the quality of the water or the state of the plumbing.

translations.source: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zibanga ukukhalaza okunjalo, kungani zihluleka zinsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezinto zokuthutha abafaneleki? Noma kunokuthile okubaluleke kakhudlwana okwenzekayo yini?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.hypothesis: Why are transportation systems causing so much frustration, and why do they fail so often? Are the engineers who design these systems not up to the task? Or is there something more fundamental at play?

translations.source: Ukugeleza Kwethrafikhi kuwucwaningo lokuhamba komshayeli ngamunye nezimoto phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili kanye nokusebenzisana abakwenzayo komunye nomunye.
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.hypothesis: Traffic flow analysis is the study of how individual drivers and vehicles move between two points, and how they interact with each other.

translations.source: Ngeshwa, ukufunda ukuhamba kwethrafikhi kunzima ngoba ukuziphatha komshayeli akukwazi ukubikezelwa ngokuqiniseka kwaphesenti ayikhulu.
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, learning to navigate traffic is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with absolute certainty.

translations.source: Ngenhlanhla, abashayeli bathambekele ekuziphatheni ngendlela ecishe ifane; ngakho ukuminyana kwezimoto kuthambekele ekufaneni futhi cishe kungafanekiswa ngokuqiniseka kwephesenti.
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.hypothesis: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave in a similar manner; therefore, the spacing between vehicles is largely consistent and can be estimated with a reasonable degree of accuracy.

translations.source: Ukufanisa kangcono ukuhamba kwezimoto, ubudlelwane bumisiwe phakathi kwezici ezintathu eziyinhloko: (1) ukuhamba, (2) ukuminyana, kanye (3) nesivinini.
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.hypothesis: To better understand traffic flow, a relationship has been established between three key factors: (1) volume, (2) density, and (3) speed.

translations.source: Lobu budlelwane buyasiza ekuhleleni, ekuklameni, kanye nasekusebenziseni izakhiwo zasemgwaqweni.
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.hypothesis: This software assists in the planning, design, and implementation of road infrastructure.

translations.source: Izinambuzane kwakuyizilwane zokuqala zokundiza. Ikhono lazo lokundiza lazisiza zigweme izitha kalula ngokwengeziwe futhi zithole ukudla kanye nomana ngokuphumelelayo kakhudlwane.
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.hypothesis: Insects were the first animals to develop the ability to fly. This ability allowed them to easily escape predators and to find food and mates more effectively.

translations.source: Izinambuzane eziningi zisizakala ngokukwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo emva komzimba wazo.
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.hypothesis: Many insects benefit from being able to fold their wings neatly against their bodies.

translations.source: Lokhu kubanika indawo enkudlwana yezindawo ezincane zokucashela izilwane ezizingelayo.
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.hypothesis: This provides a small area for observing animals in their natural habitat.

translations.source: Namuhla, ukuphela kwezinambuzane ezingakwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo izinzekamanzi nosathamanzi.
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Today, the decline of bee populations is a serious environmental and economic concern.

translations.source: Eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane eyedlule, indoda ebizwa ngo-Aristarchus yathi Isimiso sikaNozungezilanga sasizungeza iLanga.
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.hypothesis: Thousands of years ago, a man named Aristarchus proposed that the Earth and the other planets revolve around the Sun.

translations.source: Abanye abantu babecabanga ukuthi unembile kodwa abantu abaningi babekholelwa okuhlukile; ukuthi Isimo Samapulanethi Sokuzungeza Ilanga sasizungeza uMhlaba, kuhlanganise neLanga (kanye nezinye izinkanyezi).
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.hypothesis: Some people believed that the Earth was the center of the universe, but many others held a different belief: that the Sun, along with the other stars, revolved around the Earth.

translations.source: Lokhu kubonakala kunengqondo, ngenxa yokuthi uMhlaba awuzwakali sengathi uyanyakaza, akunjalo?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.hypothesis: This seems logical, because the Earth doesn't appear to be moving, does it?

translations.source: UMfula i-Amazon ngumfula wesibili omude nomkhulu kunayo yonke eMhlabeni. Unamanzi aphindwe izikhathi ezingaphezu kuka-8 kunomfula wesibili omkhulu kunayo yonke.
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the second-longest and largest river in the world. It contains more water than the second-largest river in the world, combined.

translations.source: I-Amazon ibuye ibe umfula obanzi kunayo yonke eMhlabeni, kwezinye izikhathi amamayela ayisithupha ububanzi.
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon is also the largest river in the world, sometimes reaching a width of six miles.

translations.source: Amaphesenti angu-20 agcwele amanzi ageleza esuka emifuleni yepulanethi aye ezilwandle asuka e-Amazon.
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.hypothesis: Twenty percent of the water flowing from rivers around the planet and into the oceans originates from the Amazon River.

translations.source: Umfula i-Amazon oyinhloko ungama-6,387 km (amamayela angu-3,980). Uqoqa amanzi kusuka emifudlaneni eyizinkulungwane.
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the longest river in the world, measuring 6,387 km (approximately 3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of tributaries.

translations.source: Nakuba ukwakha amaphiramidi ngamatshe kwaqhubeka kwaze kwaba sekupheleni koMbuso Omdala, amaphiramidi aseGaza awakaze adlulwe ngobukhulu kanye nangobuhle bobuchwepheshe ekwakhiweni kwawo.
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.hypothesis: While the construction of pyramids from stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza never surpassed their predecessors in size or in the sophistication of their construction.

translations.source: Umbuso Omusha eGibhithe lamandulo labamba ongezansi ngezikhumbuzo zabanduleli babo, ezazineminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane ubudala ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Egyptian kingdom was renowned for its impressive monuments, many of which were over a thousand years old at the time.

translations.source: Abantu beDolobha lase-Vatican bacishe babe ngu-800. Izwe elizimele elincane kunalo wonke emhlabeni nezwe elinabantu abancane kunabo bonke.
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.hypothesis: The population of Vatican City is approximately 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world, both in terms of land area and population.

translations.source: Idolabha lase-Vatican lisebenzisa imithetho yaseNtaliyane kanye nezilimi ezisemthethweni.
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.hypothesis: The Vatican court system operates under Italian law and uses Italian as its official language.

translations.source: IsiNtaliyane sibuye sibe ulimi lwansuku zonke olusetshenziswa iningi lalabo abasebenza esifundeni kuyilapho isiLatin sivame ukusebenziswa emikhosini engokwenkolo.
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.hypothesis: Italian is also a common language used by many people working in the education sector, while Latin is more often used in religious contexts.

translations.source: Zonke izakhamuzi zeDolobha laseVatican zingamaRoma Katolika.
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.hypothesis: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholics.

translations.source: Abantu babazi ngezakhi zamakhemikhali eziyisisekelo njengegolide, isiliva, kanye nethusi kusukela endulo, njengoba lezi zingatholakala endalweni ngohlobo lwendabuko futhi kulula kakhulu uguzigubha ngamathuluzi wasendulo.
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.hypothesis: People have known about basic chemical elements like gold, silver, and lead for a long time, as these elements can be found in nature and are relatively easy to extract using traditional tools.

translations.source: U-Aristotle, isazi sefilosofi, wayenombono wokuthi zonke izinto zenziwe ingxube yento eyodwa noma ezengeziwe kwezine ezingumsuka wezinto zonke. Bezingumhlaba, amanzi, umoya, kanye nomlilo.
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle, the philosopher, believed that all things were composed of a combination of a single element or were additions to the four elements that were the fundamental building blocks of everything. These elements were earth, water, air, and fire.

translations.source: Lokhu bekucishe kufane nezigaba ezine zezinto ezikhona (ngesigaba esifanayo): eziqinile, uketshezi, igesi, kanye ne-plasma, nakuba abuye aba nombono wokuthi zingashintsha zibe izinto ezintsha ezakha lokho esikubonayo.
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.hypothesis: This was similar to the four states of matter (in the same category): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, although he also had the idea that they could transform into new substances that make up what we see.

translations.source: Ingxubaniso ngokuyisisekelo ingxube yezinsimbi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Ungakhohlwa ukuthi kunezakhi eziningi eshadini lezakhi zamakhemikhali.
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.hypothesis: Essentially, a compound is a combination of two or more elements. It's important to remember that there are many different types of compounds in the field of chemistry.

translations.source: Izakhi ezinjengekhalsiyamu nephothaziyamu zithathwa njengensimbi. Yebo, kunezinye izinsimbi njengesiliva negolide.
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.hypothesis: Elements like calcium and phosphorus are considered minerals. Yes, there are other minerals as well, such as silver and gold.

translations.source: Ungaba futhi nezidungo ezixutshanisiwe ezihlanganisa amanani amancane ezinto ezingezona ezensimbi njenge-carbon.
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.hypothesis: It can also include composite materials that incorporate small amounts of non-metallic elements, such as carbon.

translations.source: Yonke into Embulungeni yenziwe izakhi. Zonke izakhi zenziwe izinhlayiyana ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-athomu.
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.hypothesis: Everything in the universe is made of building blocks. These building blocks are tiny particles called atoms.

translations.source: Ama-athomu mancane ngokumangalisayo kangangokuba ayizigidi eziyizigidi angalingana kungqi osekugcineni kwalomusho.
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.hypothesis: The atoms are so incredibly small that trillions of them could fit on the tip of a needle.

translations.source: Kanjalo, umsizi waba umngane omuhle wabantu abaningi uma uphuma.
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the assistant became a good friend to many people after they left.

translations.source: Ngokudabukisayo, njengoba izindlela zokubhala ezintsha zivelile, umsizi inikwe isimo nomsebenzi ophansana.
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, with the emergence of new writing styles, the role and function of the assistant have become somewhat diminished.

translations.source: Abantu manje babhala imilayezo ezikrinini zamakhompyutha, bangasadingi ukusondela emshinini wokucija amapensela.
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.hypothesis: Nowadays, people write messages on computer screens and no longer need to be close to a typewriter.

translations.source: Umuntu angazibuza ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngekhibhodi lapho kufika okuthile okusha.
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.hypothesis: One might wonder what will happen to the keyboard when something new arrives.

translations.source: Ibhomu le-fission lisebenza ngohlelo lokuthi lithathe amandla liwahlanganise njenge-nucleus kanye namaprothoni amaningi namanyutroni.
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.hypothesis: A fission bomb operates on the principle of taking energy and combining it with a nucleus, along with a large number of protons and neutrons.

translations.source: Kufana nokugingqela ikalishi elisindayo phezulu egqumeni. Ukuhlukanisa i-nucleus futhi bese kukhululwa amanye walawo mandla.
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.hypothesis: It's like cracking a hard shell at the top of a mountain, and then releasing the energy contained within. Separating the core and unleashing some of that power.

translations.source: Amanye ama-athomu anobuphakathi obuxegayo okusho ukuthi avame ukuphuka lapho eqhikinyezwa kancane noma lapho engaqhikinyezwanga.
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.hypothesis: Some atoms have unstable nuclei, which means they are likely to decay or break down, even with minimal external pressure or without any external pressure at all.

translations.source: Ingaphakathi leNyanga kwenziwe ngamatshe kanye nothuli. Ingxenye engaphandle yeNyanga ibizwa ngokuthi uqweqwe.
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.hypothesis: The core of the moon is made of rock and dust. The outer layer of the moon is called the mantle.

translations.source: Ungqimba cishe lungugqinsi olungama-70 km ohlangothini oluseduze kanye nogqinsi olungama-100 km ohlangothini olukude.
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.hypothesis: The island is approximately 70 kilometers wide at its narrowest point and 100 kilometers wide at its widest point.

translations.source: Izacile ngaphansi kolwandle futhi lungugqinsi ngaphansi kwezinkangala.
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.hypothesis: It is located underwater and is hidden beneath the rocks.

translations.source: Kungenzeka kube nezindawo zasenyangeni eziningi ezimnyama ohlangothini ngoba ungqimba luzacile. Bekulula ngodaka olushisayo ukukhuphukela phezulu.
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.hypothesis: There were likely many dark, rocky areas on the side because the soil was thin. It was easy to climb upwards thanks to the warm, dry weather.

translations.source: Imicabango yezizathu zokushintsha kwabantu igxile ezintweni ezishukumisa abantu noma ezithinta izinhliziyo zabo.
translations.reference: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.hypothesis: The theories about the reasons for human change focus on the factors that motivate people or that affect their emotions.

translations.source: Le mibono isikisela ukuthi abantu banezidingo ezithile kanye/noma izifiso eziye zavalelwa ngaphakathi njengoba zikhulela ekubeni zindala.
translations.reference: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.hypothesis: These observations suggest that people develop certain needs and/or desires that become suppressed as they grow older.

translations.source: Le mibono ihlola ukuthi yini eyenza abanye abantu bafune izinto abazifunayo nokuthi yiziphi izinto endaweni yabo ezizobenza benze noma bangenzi ezinye izinto.
translations.reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.hypothesis: These ideas explore what motivates some people to pursue certain goals and what factors in their environment might encourage or discourage them from doing so.

translations.source: Imicabango eshukumisayo emibili ethandwayo yiHierarchy of Needs Theory kaMaslow kanye neTwo Factor Theory kaHertzberg.
translations.reference: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.hypothesis: Two popular and influential theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs and Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory.

translations.source: Ngokukhuluma nje, ukuziphatha okubili kungahlangana njengoba abaphathi beqala ukuhola amawembu ababesebenzisana nabo.. Omunye uzama ukuba “ingxenye yabafana” (noma amantombazane).
translations.reference: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.hypothesis: Simply put, the two behaviors can converge as managers begin to lead the teams they work with. One approach attempts to be "one of the guys" (or girls).

translations.source: Lolu hlobo lwemenenja luba nobunzima uma kufunanele lwenze izinqumo ezingathandeki, ukuqondisa izigwegwe zabasebenzi, ukuhlolwa kokusebenza, ukwabiwa komsebenzi, nokwenza abantu baziphendulele ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This type of management can be challenging when it comes to making unpopular decisions, directing employee behavior, conducting performance evaluations, assigning tasks, and holding people accountable for their work.

translations.source: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umuntu uyaguquka abe ngumuntu ongasabonakali ukuthi ungubani ozizwa sengathi kumelwe ashintshe konke obekwenziwa iqembu futhi akwenze okwakhe.
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: On the other hand, a person might undergo a transformation, becoming someone unrecognizable, feeling as though they need to change everything the group does and impose their own way of doing things.

translations.source: Ngemva kwakho konke, abaholi ibona abonomthwalo wangempela wemfanelo wokuphumelela nokuhluleka kweqembu.
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, leaders bear the true responsibility for a team's success or failure.

translations.source: Le ndlela yokuziphatha ezikhathini eziningi libangela ukwahlukana phakathi kwabaholi nethimba lonke.
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: This type of behavior often leads to a disconnect between leaders and the rest of the team.

translations.source: Amaqembu abukeka njengangokoqobo aphathwa ngezimiso ezifanayo zobuhle njengamaqembu angokwesiko, kepha kunomehluko ocashile.
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.hypothesis: These groups, while appearing similar to traditional groups, are managed according to the same principles of aesthetics, but there are significant differences.

translations.source: Amalungu weqembu wekhompyutha avame ukusebenza njengendawo yokuxhumana yamalungu aseduze kakhulu eqembu elingokoqobo.
translations.reference: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.hypothesis: Members of a computer team often function as a communication hub for the individuals who are most closely involved in the team's work.

translations.source: Ngokuvamile banenkululeko yokuzimela kakhulu kunamalungu eqembu avamile njengoba amaqembu abo angahlangana ngokuya ngezikhathi zendawo ezihlukene okungenzeka kungaqondwa abaphathi basendaweni.
translations.reference: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.hypothesis: Generally, they have more autonomy than typical group members, as their groups can meet at various locations and times, which may not be easily monitored by local authorities.

translations.source: Ukuba khona “kweqembu elingabonakali” langempela (uLarson noLaFasto, 1989, k109) kubuye kube yisici esikhethekile seqembu ekungelona elingokoqobo.
translations.reference: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.hypothesis: The actual presence of an "invisible group" (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p. 109) is also a distinctive characteristic of a virtual team.

translations.source: Iqembu elingabonakali iqembu labaphathi lelo ilungu ngalinye elilandisa kubo. Iqembu elingabonakali libekela ilungu ngalinye izindinganiso.
translations.reference: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.hypothesis: An invisible team is a management team where each member reports to it. The invisible team sets standards for each member.

translations.source: Kungani inhlangano ingafuna ukusebenza ngenqubo edla isikhathi yokumisa inhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo? Umgomo owodwa wokusebenzisa imibono yenhlangano efundisa amalungu ayo amacebo.
translations.reference: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.hypothesis: Why might an organization choose to use a lengthy process to establish a training program for its members? One reason is to ensure that the training program aligns with the organization's overall goals and objectives.

translations.source: Uma zonke izinsiza-kusebenza zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo eminyanweni esebenzayo yenhlangano, ukusungula nobuhlakani kungenzeka.
translations.reference: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.hypothesis: When all available resources are effectively utilized within an organization's operational areas, innovation and progress are more likely to occur.

translations.source: Ngenxa yalokho, inqubo yokuba inhlangano isebenze ndawonye ukuze inqobe isithiyo ingaholela enqubweni etsha yamacebo okunaka izidingo zekhasimende.
translations.reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the process of an organization working together to overcome challenges can lead to the development of innovative solutions that address customer needs.

translations.source: Ngaphambi kokuba inhlangano ibe namacebo, abaholi kumelwe benze isiko lokusungula amacebo kanye nolwazi oluhlanganyelwayo nokufundisa amalungu enhlangano.
translations.reference: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.hypothesis: Before an organization can implement plans, its leaders must establish a culture of collaborative planning and share knowledge and provide training to the organization's members.

translations.source: U-Angel (2006), uchaza indlela yeContinuum njengendlela esetshenziselwa ukusiza izinhlangano zifinyelele ezingeni eliphakeme lokusebenza.
translations.reference: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.hypothesis: Angel (2006) describes the Continuum approach as a method used to help organizations achieve a higher level of performance.

translations.source: Idatha ye-Neurobiological inikeza ubufakazi obubonakalayo bendlela yethiyori ekuphenyweni kokuqaphela. Ngakho-ke, inciphisa umkhakha wocwaningo futhi iwenze unembe kakhudlwana.
translations.reference: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
translations.hypothesis: Neurobiological data provides empirical evidence to support theoretical frameworks in research on perception. Consequently, it narrows the scope of research and makes it more focused.

translations.source: Ukuhlanganiswa ngokuqhathaniswa phakathi kwesayensi yezifo zobuchopho kanye nokuziphatha kusekela ososayensi ocwaningweni lwabo.
translations.reference: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
translations.hypothesis: The integration of comparative analysis between neuroscience and psychology supports scientists in their research.

translations.source: Kudala kwaziwa ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukile zokulimala kobuchopho, ukuhlukumezeka, izilonda, kanye nokhwekhwe kuthinta ukuziphatha futhi kubangela ushintsho kokunye kokusebenza kwengqondo.
translations.reference: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
translations.hypothesis: It is well-established that different types of brain injuries, trauma, lesions, and tumors can affect behavior and cause changes in certain cognitive functions.

translations.source: Ukuba khona kwezobuchwepheshe ezintsha kusivumela ukuba sibone futhi sihlole ukwakheka kwengqondo kanye nezinqubo ezingakaze zibonwe ngaphambili.
translations.reference: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
translations.hypothesis: The emergence of new technologies allows us to observe and explore mental structures and processes that were previously unknown.

translations.source: Lokhu kusinika ukwaziswa okuningi nezinto zokwakha imishini yokulingisa esisiza siqonde indlela zokusebenza kwengqondo.
translations.reference: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
translations.hypothesis: This provides us with valuable insights and tools for building models that help us understand how the mind works.

translations.source: Nakuba i-AI inomqondo oqinilile wezindaba eziqanjiwe zesayensi, i-AI yenza ingxenye ebalulekile kakhulu yesayensi yamakhompyutha, ebukana nokuziphatha, ukufunda kanye nokusebenza komshini kokuhlakanipha.
translations.reference: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
translations.hypothesis: While AI encompasses a broad range of scientific topics, AI also forms a crucial part of computer science, focusing on the behavior, learning, and operation of intelligent machines.

translations.source: Ucwaningo lwezamarobothi luhlanganisa ukwenza imishini yenze ngokuzenzakalekayo imisebenzi edinga ukucabanga komuntu.
translations.reference: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
translations.hypothesis: The field of robotics involves creating machines that can automatically perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.

translations.source: Izibonelo zihlanganisa ukulawula, ukuhlela nokwenza isheduli, ikhono lokuphendula ukubhula nemibuzo yekhasimende, kanye nokuqaphela ngesandla, izwi nobuso.
translations.reference: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
translations.hypothesis: Examples include managing, scheduling, and organizing tasks; the ability to respond to inquiries and customer requests; and attention to detail, both verbal and non-verbal.

translations.source: Izinto ezinjalo zibe izimiso ezihlukile, ezigxila ekunikezeni izisombululo zezinkinga ezingokoqobo zokuphila.
translations.reference: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
translations.hypothesis: Such things become distinct principles, aimed at providing solutions to real-life problems.

translations.source: Uhlelo lwe-AI manje ngokuvamile lusetshenziswa emkhakheni wezomnotho, ezokwelapha, ubunjiniyela kanye nempi, njengoba kwakhiwe ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zamakhompyutha wasekhaya amaningana nemidlalo yevidiyo.
translations.reference: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
translations.hypothesis: Artificial intelligence is now commonly used in fields such as economics, medicine, engineering, and military applications, and it has been integrated into many home computer systems and video games.

translations.source: Uhambo lwesikole seluyingxenye enkulu yekilasi. Kaningi uthisha angathanda ukuyisa abafundi bakhe ezindaweni lapho kungafikeki khona ngohambo lwebhasi.
translations.reference: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
translations.hypothesis: School trips are a significant part of the educational experience. Teachers often like to take their students to places that are not easily accessible by bus.

translations.source: Ezobuchwepheshe zinikeza isisombululo ngohambo lwesikole olubukeka njengolwangempela. Abafunda bangabuka imivubukulo yasemnyuziyamu, bavakashele indawo yokugcina izinhlanzi, noma bajabulele ubuhle bobuciko belokhu behlezi nekilasi labo.
translations.reference: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
translations.hypothesis: Technology offers a solution for school trips that feels truly immersive. Students can explore museum exhibits, visit an aquarium, or appreciate works of art, all while remaining in their classroom.

translations.source: Ukuhlanganyela uhambo lwesikole cishe enye indlela enhle kakhulu yokucabangisisa ohambweni nokwabelana ngokwenzekile namakilasi wesikhathi esizayo.
translations.reference: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
translations.hypothesis: Participating in a school trip is often a wonderful way to broaden students' horizons and share experiences with their classmates for years to come.

translations.source: Ngokwesibonelo, unyaka nonyaka abafundi baseBennet School eNorth Carolina baklama iwebhusayithi mayelana nohambo lwabo oluya eNhloko-dolobha Yombuso, unyaka ngamunye amawebhusayithi akhiwa kabusha futhi, kodwa izinhlobo ezindala ziyagcinwa kuyi-inthanethi ukuthi isebenze njengencwadi yokugcina izinto.
translations.reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
translations.hypothesis: For example, each year, the students at Bennet School in North Carolina create a website about their trip to the nation's capital. Every year, these websites are updated, but older versions are archived online to serve as a kind of digital record.

translations.source: Amabhulogi angasiza abafundi ngokubhala. Nakuba abafundi kaningi baqala umsebenzi wabo wokubhuloga ngendlela yokubhala nokupela yobudlabha, ukuba khona kwezilaleli kaningi kuyakushintsha lokho.
translations.reference: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.hypothesis: Blogs can help students with their writing. While students often start blogging as a way to improve their writing skills and express themselves, the presence of an audience can often change that.

translations.source: Njengoba abafundi ngokuvamile bayizilaleli ezigxeka kakhulu, umbhali webhulogi uqala ukulwela ukuthuthukisa ukubhala ukuze akweme ukugxekwa.
translations.reference: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
translations.hypothesis: As students are often the most critical audience, the blogger begins to strive for improvement in their writing in order to avoid criticism.

translations.source: Futhi ukubhuloga "kuphoqa abafundi ukuba babenokuqonda kakhudlwana ngezwe elibazungezile." Isidingo sokondla isithakazelo sabantu abafundayo kushukumisa abafundi ukuba bahlakaniphe futhi bathakazelise (Toto, 2004).
translations.reference: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, "travel encourages students to develop a deeper understanding of the country they are visiting." The need to satisfy the curiosity of learners motivates students to become more knowledgeable and engaged (Toto, 2004).

translations.source: Ukubhuloga ithuluzi elikhuthaza ukubambisana, futhi likhuthaza abafundi ukuba bangagcini ngokufunda osukwini lwesikole oluvamile.
translations.reference: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.hypothesis: Tutoring is a tool that promotes collaboration and encourages students to learn beyond the regular school day.

translations.source: Indlela efanele yokusebenzisa amabhulogi “inganika abafundi amandla okuba abahlakahlayo nabahlolisisayo kakhudlwana; abafundi bangachaza izikhundla zabo ngomongo wemibhalo yabanye kanye nokusho imibono yabo ngezindaba ezithile (Oravec, 2002).
translations.reference: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: The proper use of blogs can empower readers to become more active and critical participants; readers can express their perspectives on the content of others' posts and share their own opinions on specific topics (Oravec, 2002).

translations.source: I-Ottawa inhlokodolobha yaseKhanada enhle, enezilimi ezimbili futhi enezikhungo eziningi zobuciko namamnyuziyamu abonisa izinto zaseKhanada zesikhathi esidlule nezamanye.
translations.reference: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
translations.hypothesis: Ottawa is a beautiful city, the capital of Canada, and it is a bilingual city with many cultural centers and museums that showcase Canada's history and heritage.

translations.source: Eningizimu ekude kuneNiagara Falls kanti enyakatho iyikhaya lobuhle bemvelo obungasetshenzisiwe beMuskoka nangale kwayo.
translations.reference: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
translations.hypothesis: Located to the south of Niagara Falls, and to the north of the pristine, undeveloped natural beauty of Muskoka and its surrounding areas.

translations.source: Zonke lezi zinto nokuningi kugcizelela i-Ontario njengebhekwa njengeyaseKhanada uqobo lwayo abantu bangaphandle.
translations.reference: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
translations.hypothesis: All of these factors, and many more, highlight Ontario's position as a key destination for immigrants seeking a better life in Canada.

translations.source: Izindawo eziningi kude le enyakatho zinabantu abambalwa futhi ezinye cishe zingugwadule olungahlali muntu.
translations.reference: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
translations.hypothesis: Many areas in the far north are sparsely populated, and some are practically uninhabited, resembling deserted wilderness.

translations.source: Uma kuqhathaniswa isibalo sabantu esingamangalisa abaningi: Baningi abantu baseAfrika-Melika abahlala e-US kunezakhamuzi zaseCanada
translations.reference: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
translations.hypothesis: Compared to the number of people we are talking about, it's quite significant: There are more African Americans living in the United States than there are citizens in Canada.

translations.source: Iziqhingi zaseMpumalanga Afrika zisoLwandlekazini lwaseNdiya ngasogwini olusempumalanga ye-Afrika.
translations.reference: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The islands of East Africa are located in the Indian Ocean, off the eastern coast of Africa.

translations.source: IMadagascar yiyo enkulu kakhulu, futhi iyizwekazi ngokwayo uma kuziwa ezilwaneni zasendle.
translations.reference: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Madagascar is the largest island, and it is a unique country when it comes to its natural wildlife.

translations.source: Eziningi zeziqhingi ezincane izizwe ezizimele, noma zihlangene neFulansi, futhi zaziwa njendawo yokuvakashela engasolwandle kanokusho.
translations.reference: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
translations.hypothesis: Many of these small islands are independent nations, or are associated with France, and are known as popular tourist destinations, especially for beach vacations.

translations.source: Ama-Arabhu nawo aletha ubuSulumane emazweni, futhi kwathatha indlela enkulu eComoros naseMayotte.
translations.reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
translations.hypothesis: The Arabs also brought Islam to these countries, and it had a significant impact on both Comoros and Mayotte.

translations.source: Ithonya laseYurophu kanye nobukoloni kwaqala ngekhulu leminyaka lama-15, njengoba inhloli yomPutukezi u-Vasco da Gama ithola Indlela yaseKapa kusuka eYurophu ukuya eNdiya.
translations.reference: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
translations.hypothesis: European exploration and colonialism began in the 15th century, with the Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama discovering the Cape Route from Europe to India.

translations.source: Endaweni esenyakatho ikhawuliswe yiSahel, futhi eningizimu kanye nasentshonalanga uLwandlekazi i-Atlantic.
translations.reference: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
translations.hypothesis: The region in the north is bordered by the Sahel, while to the south and west it is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: Abesifazane: Kutuswa ukuthi noma ngabe yiziphi izivakashi zesifazane zithi zishadile, kungakhathalekile ukuthi zishadile yini noma azishadile.
translations.reference: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
translations.hypothesis: Women: It is important to note that regardless of the gender of the visitor, whether they are married or not is irrelevant.

translations.source: Kuyasiza nokufaka indandatho (kodwa hayi ebukeka ibiza.
translations.reference: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
translations.hypothesis: It also helps to wear a hat (but not one that looks too expensive).

translations.source: Abesifazane kumelwe baqaphele ukuthi ukungafani kwamasiko kungaholela kulokho abangacabanga ukuthi ukuhlushwa futhi akukhona okungavamile ukulandelwa, ukubanjwa ngengalo, njll.
translations.reference: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
translations.hypothesis: Women should be aware that cultural differences can sometimes lead to situations that they might perceive as harassment, and this can include unwanted attention, being touched inappropriately, etc.

translations.source: Qina lapho wenqaba amadoda, futhi ungesabi ukuzimela (umehluko wamasiko noma cha, awenzi kube okulungile!).
translations.reference: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
translations.hypothesis: Stand firm where men stand, and don't be afraid to be different (cultural differences or not, it's okay to be yourself!).

translations.source: Idolobha lanamuhla laseCasablanca lasungulwa abadobi baseBerber ngekhulu lama-10 leminyaka BCE, futhi belisetshenziswa abantu baseFenike, eRoma, kanye namaMerenid njengetheku elisendaweni ekahle elibizwa nge-Anfa.
translations.reference: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
translations.hypothesis: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber tribes in the 10th century BCE and was later used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and Merinids as a port in a strategically important location called Anfa.

translations.source: AmaPutukezi alichitha futhi alakha kabusha ngaphansi kwegama leCAsa Branca, ukuze nje aliyeke dengwane ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba ngo-1755.
translations.reference: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
