translations.hypothesis: The Portuguese demolished and rebuilt the structure under the name Casa Branca, but it was eventually abandoned after the earthquake of 1755.

translations.source: Inkosi yaseMorocco yakha kabusha leli dolobha njengeDaru l-Badya futhi lanikezwa igama lokuthi iCasablanca ngabathengisi baseSpeyini abamisa izindawo zokuhweba lapho.
translations.reference: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
translations.hypothesis: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt this city as Dar al-Badya and it was later renamed Casablanca by Spanish merchants who established trading posts there.

translations.source: ICasablanca enye yezindawo ezingathakazelisi kakhulu yokuthenga kuyo eMorocco yonke.
translations.reference: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
translations.hypothesis: Casablanca is one of the most popular shopping destinations in all of Morocco.

translations.source: Eduze neMedina endala kulula ukuthola izindawo ezidayisa izinto ezingokwesiko zase-Morocco, njenge-tagines, izinto zobumba, izinto zesikhumba, amapayipi okubhema, kanye neminikilishwana eminingi yokuhlobisa, kodwa konke okwezivakashi.
translations.reference: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Near the old Medina, it's easy to find shops selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather items, smoking pipes, and various decorative trinkets, but these are mostly geared towards tourists.

translations.source: IGoma yidolobha laseDemocratic Republic of Congo elise mpumalanga eduzane naseRwanda eliheha izivakashi.
translations.reference: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
translations.hypothesis: Goma is a city in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, near the border with Rwanda, and it is a popular tourist destination.

translations.source: Ngo-2002 iGoma yabhujiswa udaka olushisayo oluvela kuyintabamlilo iNyirogongo eyagqiba eminingi yemigwaqo yasedolobheni, ikakhulukazi maphakathi nedolobha.
translations.reference: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
translations.hypothesis: In 2002, the city of Goma was devastated by a massive earthquake that triggered a landslide from the Nyiragongo volcano, which caused significant damage to roads, particularly in the city center.

translations.source: Nakuba iGoma iphephile ngokwezinga elithile, noma ikuphi ukuvakasha ngaphandle kweGoma kumelwe kucwaningwe ukuze uzwisise isimo sokulwa okusesifundazweni saseNyakatho Kivu.
translations.reference: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
translations.hypothesis: While the Goma area is relatively safe, any travel outside of Goma should be carefully considered to understand the security situation in the North Kivu province.

translations.source: Idolobha libuye libe isiqu sokugibela intabamlilo iNyiragongo kanye nokunye kokulandelela amaGorila waseNtabeni okubiza kancane kunakho konke e-Afrika.
translations.reference: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The city is also a gateway to Nyiragongo volcano and offers opportunities for gorilla trekking, which is among the most affordable in Africa.

translations.source: Uma usebenzisa i-boda-boda (itekisi lesithuthuthu) ukuhambahamba eGoma. Inani elivamile (lasendaweni) u-~500 wama-Franc wase-Congo uma ufuna uhambo olufishane.
translations.reference: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
translations.hypothesis: If you're using a "boda-boda" (a motorcycle taxi) to get around in Goma, the typical local price for a short trip is around 500 Congolese Francs.

translations.source: Kuhlanganiswe nokungafinyeleleki kuyo kalula, "iTimbuktu" seyisetshenziswa njengesingathekiso samazwe angajwayelekile, akude.
translations.reference: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
translations.hypothesis: Due to its inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has become a metaphor for remote and obscure places.

translations.source: Namuhla, iTimbuktu idolobha eliphundlekile, nakuba idumela lalo lilenza lithandwe izivakashi, futhi linesikhumulo sezindiza.
translations.reference: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
translations.hypothesis: Today, Timbuktu, a historic city, is a popular tourist destination, and it also has an airport.

translations.source: Ngo-1990, yafakwa ohlwini lwezindawo zefa lomhlaba ezisengozini, ngenxa yosongo lwesihlabathi sasohlane.
translations.reference: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
translations.hypothesis: In 1990, it was added to the list of endangered sites worldwide due to the threat of deforestation.

translations.source: Kwakungenye yezindawo zokuma phakathi nohlelo lwePBs lukaHenry Louis Gates lweZimangaliso Zezwe lase-Afrika.
translations.reference: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
translations.hypothesis: It was one of the segments featured in Henry Louis Gates' PBS series, "African American Lives."

translations.source: Idolobha lihlukile ngokuphelele kwamanye amadolobha ezwe, ngoba linomoya wase-Arabhiya kakhulu ukudlula owaseAfrika.
translations.reference: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
translations.hypothesis: The city is quite different from other cities in the country, as it has a much stronger Arab influence than a typical African city.

translations.source: IKruger National Park (KNP) isenyakatho-mpumalanga yaseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihamba ngasemngceleni weMozambique empumalanga, iZimbabwe enyakatho, futhi umngcele ongaseningizimu iCrocodile River.
translations.reference: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
translations.hypothesis: The Kruger National Park (KNP) is located in the northeastern part of South Africa, bordering Mozambique to the east, Zimbabwe to the north, and the Crocodile River to the south.

translations.source: Ubukhulu bepaki bungu-19,500 km² futhi lihlukaniswe laba yizindawo ezingokwemvelo ezingu-14, ngayinye inezidalwa zasendle ezihlukahlukene.
translations.reference: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: The park covers an area of 19,500 km² and is divided into 14 different zones, each with its own unique wildlife.

translations.source: Ingenye yezindawo ezivakashelwa kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi ithathwa njengendawo eyaziwa kakhulu kumaPaki weZwe waseNingizimu Afrika (SANParks).
translations.reference: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
translations.hypothesis: It is one of the most popular tourist destinations in South Africa and is considered a flagship destination within South African National Parks (SANParks).

translations.source: Njengawo wonke amaPaki Wezwe waseNingizimu Afrika, kunamanani okuhlanga ngaphakathi usuku ngalunye kanye namanani okungena wepaki.
translations.reference: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
translations.hypothesis: Like all national parks in South Africa, this park has daily conservation fees and entrance fees.

translations.source: Kungase futhi kube usizo ukuthi umuntu athenge i-Wild Card, enikeza ithuba lokungena kumapaki aseNingizimu Afrika noma kuwo wonke amaSouth African National Parks
translations.reference: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
translations.hypothesis: It might also be helpful for someone to purchase a Wild Card, which provides access to parks in South Africa or all South African National Parks.

translations.source: Isiqhingi saseHong Kong sinika indawo yaseHong Kong igama layo futhi yindawo leyo izivakashi eziningi eziyithatha njengendawo yokuvakashelwa eyinhloko.
translations.reference: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
translations.hypothesis: Hong Kong Island gives Hong Kong its name and is a popular destination for many tourists, who often consider it the city's main attraction.

translations.source: Umbukiso wezakhiwo ezenza isibhakabhaka saseHong Kong ufaniswe neshadi elicwebezelayo elibonakala ngokuba khona kwamanzi aseVictoria Harbour.
translations.reference: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
translations.hypothesis: The architectural exhibition in Hong Kong has been likened to a stunning painting, with the skyline reflected in the waters of Victoria Harbour.

translations.source: Ukuze ube nemibono emihle kakhulu ye-Hong Kong, shiya lesi siqhingi uye echibini lamanzi lase-Kowloon eliqondene.
translations.reference: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
translations.hypothesis: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave this island and head to the Kowloon waterfront.

translations.source: Iningi kokuthuthuka  kwedolobha laseHong Kong Island kugcwele ezweni elisanda kubuyiswa ngasogwini olusenyakatho.
translations.reference: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
translations.hypothesis: Much of the development in Hong Kong Island is concentrated in the area that was recently reclaimed from the sea on the northern coast.

translations.source: Le indawo abenzi bamakoloni baseBrithani abayithatha njengendawo yabo ngakho uma ufuna ukubona ubufakazi besikhathi esedlule sobukoloni salendawo, lena indawo efanele ongaqala kuyo.
translations.reference: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
translations.hypothesis: This area was claimed by the British colonists, so if you want to see evidence of the colonial past of this region, this is a good place to start.

translations.source: Ama-Sundarban awuchungechunge lomhlume wothungulu omkhulu kunawo wonke emhlabeni, ayindawo engama-80 km (50 mi) ukuya phakathi nezwe laseBangladesh nelaseNdiya kusuka ogwini.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans, the largest mangrove forest in the world, is a region spanning approximately 80 km (50 miles) between Bangladesh and India, stretching from the coast inland.

translations.source: I-Sundarbans ibhekwe njengeNdawo Yamagugu Omhlaba i-UNESCO. Ingxenye yehlathi elisensimini yabaseNdiya libizwa ngokuthi i-Ipaki Lesizwe i-Sundarbans
translations.reference: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This part of the Indian subcontinent is known as the Sundarbans National Park.

translations.source: Amahlathi awagcini nje ngokuba amaxhaphozi anemihlume — ahlanganisa ezinye zezindawo zokugcina ezisele zamahlathi anamandla ake ahlanganisa ithafa lase-Gangetic.
translations.reference: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
translations.hypothesis: Forests are not just collections of trees; they also include some of the most important ecosystems, including the Gangetic plain forests.

translations.source: Ama-Sundarbans enza indawo engama-3,850 km², leyo ingxenye yesithathu yayo yembozwe yizindawo ezingamanzi/ubhuku.
translations.reference: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
translations.hypothesis: The Sundarbans covers an area of 3,850 square kilometers, of which approximately one-third is covered by water, including rivers, canals, and creeks.

translations.source: Kusukela ngo-1966 amaSundarbans abeyindawo yokuhlala izilwane zasendle, futhi kulinganiselwa ukuthi manje sekunamahlosi waseBukhosini wase-Bengal kanye nezinyamazane ezinamabala ezicishe zibe ngu-30,000 endaweni.
translations.reference: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1966, the Sundarbans has been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now approximately 30,000 Bengal tigers and numerous colorful bird species living in the area.

translations.source: Amabhasi asuka esiteshi samabhasi esiphakathi kwesifunda (ngaphesheya komfula) usuku lonke, nakuba amaningi, ikakhulukazi lawo aya ngasempumalanga naseJakar/Bumthang asuka phakathi kuka-06:30 no-07:30.
translations.reference: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
translations.hypothesis: Buses depart from the central bus station (across the river) throughout the day, although many, especially those heading east to Jakar/Bumthang, leave between 6:30 AM and 7:30 AM.

translations.source: Njengoba amabhasi esifunda ngokuvamile egcwala, kuyatuseka ukuthi uthenge ithikithi ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngaphambili.
translations.reference: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
translations.hypothesis: As the buses in our area are often crowded, we recommend purchasing your ticket a few days in advance.

translations.source: Izifunda eziningi zihlinzekwa i-Japanese Coaster Buses amancane, akhululekile futhi aqinile.
translations.reference: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
translations.hypothesis: Many areas are served by small, convenient, and reliable Japanese coaster buses.

translations.source: Amatekisi ahlanganyelwayo ayindlela esheshayo nenethezekile yokuya ezindaweni eziseduze, njengase-Paro (Nu 150) kanye nase-Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.reference: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
translations.hypothesis: Shared taxis are a quick and convenient way to travel to nearby destinations, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).

translations.source: I-Oyapock River Bridge ibhuloho eliphaswe ngamakhebula ensimbi. Liwelela uMfula i-Oyapock uhlanganisa amadolobha ase-Oiapque eBrazil kanye neSaint-Georges de I'Oyapock eFrench Guiana.
translations.reference: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
translations.hypothesis: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed steel bridge. It spans the Oyapock River, connecting the town of Oiapoque in Brazil with Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.

translations.source: Imibhoshongo emibili iphakama ngamamitha angu-83, ingamamitha angu-378 ubude futhi inemigwaqo emibili engu-3.50 m ububanzi.
translations.reference: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
translations.hypothesis: The two bridges are 83 meters high, 378 meters long, and have two lanes, each 3.50 meters wide.

translations.source: Isikhala sokuphakama esisalayo ngaphansi kwebhuloho singamamitha angu-15. Ukulakha kwaphela ngoNcwaba 2011, alivulwanga ukuze kuhambe izimoto kwaze kwaba uNdasa 2017.
translations.reference: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
translations.hypothesis: The height of the tunnel, which is located under the railway line, is 15 meters. Construction was completed in December 2011, but it was not opened to vehicular traffic until August 2017.

translations.source: Ibhuloho lihlelelwe ukusebenza ngokugcwele ngoMandulo 2017, lapho izindawo zaseBrazil zokuhlola abangenayo kulindelwe ukuthi ziphele.
translations.reference: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
translations.hypothesis: The facility is scheduled to be fully operational by July 2017, at which point the Brazilian testing sites are expected to be completed.

translations.source: Ama-Guarani bekuyiqembu lomdabu eliphawulekayo elinefa kulokho manje okuthiwa iMpumalanga Paraguay, baphila ngokuba abazingeli futhi bathola ukudla ngokulima.
translations.reference: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
translations.hypothesis: The Guarani were a prominent indigenous group who lived in what is now eastern Paraguay. They were primarily nomadic and obtained their food through agriculture.

translations.source: Indawo yaseChaco bekuyikhaya lamanye amaqembu wezizwana zemdabu njengamaGuaycurú kanye namaPayaguá, ababephila ngokuzingela, ukubutha kanye nokudoba.
translations.reference: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
translations.hypothesis: The Chaco region was home to various indigenous groups, such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who lived by hunting, gathering, and fishing.

translations.source: Ngekhulu lesi-16 leminyaka iParaguay, ngaphambili eyayibizwa ngokuthi "Isifundazwe Esikhulukazi sama-Indie", yaba khona ngenxa yokuhlangana kwabanqobi baseSpain namaqembu abantu bomdabu ngokuzalwa.
translations.reference: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
translations.hypothesis: In the 16th century, Paraguay, formerly known as the "Viceroyalty of the Indies," came into existence as a result of the interaction between Spanish conquerors and the indigenous populations.

translations.source: AbaseSpain baqala isikhathi sobukoloni esathatha amakhulu amathathu eminyaka.
translations.reference: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The Spanish began a period of colonization that lasted for three centuries.

translations.source: Kusukela ekusungulweni kwe Asunción ngo-1537, i-Paraguay yakwazi ukugcina isimo sayo sendabuko esikhulu kanye nobukhona bayo.
translations.reference: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
translations.hypothesis: Since its founding in 1537, Paraguay has managed to preserve much of its cultural heritage and its unique identity.

translations.source: I-Argentina idume ngokuba nelinye lamaqembu kanye nabadlali be-polo abahamba phambili emhlabeni.
translations.reference: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
translations.hypothesis: Argentina is renowned for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.

translations.source: Umncintiswano omkhulu kunayo yonke wonyaka wenzeka ngoZibandlela ezinkundleni ze-polo eLas Cañitas.
translations.reference: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
translations.hypothesis: The biggest competition of the year took place last weekend at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.

translations.source: Imincintiswano emincane kanye nemidlalo ingabuye ibonwe lapha ngezinye izikhathi zonyaka.
translations.reference: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
translations.hypothesis: Small competitions and games are also sometimes held here throughout the year.

translations.source: Ukuze uthole izindaba zemincintiswano kanye nendawo yokuthenga amathikithi wemidlalo yepholo, hlola i-Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.reference: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
translations.hypothesis: To find information about tournaments and to purchase tickets for polo matches, please visit the website of the Argentine Polo Association.

translations.source: Imali esemthethweni yase-Falkland iwupondo waseFalkland (FKP) inani layo libekwe endaweni efanayo nopondo waseBrithani (GBP).
translations.reference: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
translations.hypothesis: The official currency of the Falkland Islands is the Falkland Pound (FKP), and its value is pegged to the British Pound (GBP).

translations.source: Imali ingashintshwa ebhange okuwukuphela kwalo esiqhingini esiseStanley ngaphesheya kwesitolo saseFIC Ntshonalanga.
translations.reference: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
translations.hypothesis: The money can only be exchanged at the bank located on the island near the FIC store in Stanley.

translations.source: Amaphawundi wase-Britain ngokuvamile azokwamukelwa noma yikuphi eziqhingini futhi nangaphakathi amakhadi wesikweletu e-Stanley kanye namadola ase-United States nawo ajwayele ukwamukelwa.
translations.reference: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
translations.hypothesis: British pounds are generally accepted throughout the islands, and Stanley credit cards, as well as United States dollars, are also commonly accepted.

translations.source: Eziqhingini eziqhelile amakhadi wokuthenga ngesikweletu cishe ngeke amukelwe, nakuba imali yaseBrithani naseMelika ingathathwa; hlola nabanikazi kusengaphambili ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela yokukhokha eyamukelwayo.
translations.reference: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
translations.hypothesis: Generally, credit cards are not widely accepted on these islands, although British and American currency is usually accepted. It's best to check with the establishments beforehand to find out which payment methods they accept.

translations.source: Cishe akwenzeki ukushintshelana imali yaseFalklands ngaphandlwe kweziqhingi, ngakho-ke shintshelana imali ngaphambi kokuhamba eziqhingini.
translations.reference: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
translations.hypothesis: It is almost impossible to exchange currency within the Falkland Islands, so it is best to exchange your money before traveling to the islands.

translations.source: Njengoba i-Montevideo iseningizimu yeNkabazwe, kuba ihlobo lapho ngesikhathi Ingxenye eseNyakatho kusebusika kuyaphambana.
translations.reference: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
translations.hypothesis: Since Montevideo is located in the southern hemisphere, it experiences seasons that are opposite to those in the northern hemisphere; that is, when the northern hemisphere is experiencing winter, Montevideo is experiencing summer.

translations.source: IMontevideo isendaweni yetropiki; ngezinyanga zasehlobo, amazinga okushisa angaphezu kuka +30°C avamile.
translations.reference: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
translations.hypothesis: Montevideo is located in a tropical region; during the summer months, temperatures often exceed +30°C.

translations.source: Ubusika bungaba nzima kakhulu: amazing okushisa angase adlulele ngale kweqhwa, kodwa umoya kanye nomswakama sekuhlangene kwenza kubande ngaphezu kwalokho isikali sokushisa esikushoyo.
translations.reference: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
translations.hypothesis: Winter can be very harsh: while the temperatures might drop below freezing, the combination of wind and humidity makes it feel even colder than the thermometer reading suggests.

translations.source: Azikho izikhathi eziqondile “zemvula” noma “zobusika”: izinga lemvula lihlala linjalo cishe unyaka wonke.
translations.reference: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
translations.hypothesis: There are no distinct "rainy" or "dry" seasons; the rainfall remains relatively consistent throughout the year.

translations.source: Nakuba izilwane eziningi epaki zijwayele ukubona abantu, izilwane zasendle noma kunjalo aziphucukile futhi akumelwe zondliwe noma ziphazanyiswe.
translations.reference: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
translations.hypothesis: While many of the animals in the park are accustomed to seeing people, wild animals are still wild and should not be fed or disturbed.

translations.source: Ngokweziphathimandla zepaki, hlala okungenani amayadi/amamitha angu-100 kude namabhere kanye nezimpisi ezifana namanketshane futhi amayadi/amamitha angu-25 kuzo zonke ezinye izilwane zasendle!
translations.reference: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
translations.hypothesis: According to park regulations, maintain a distance of at least 100 yards/meters from bears and large predators like wolves, and 25 yards/meters from all other wildlife!

translations.source: Kungakhathelekile ukuthi zibukeka zithobile kangakanani, izinyathi, ama-elk, ama-moose, amabhere, futhi cishe nazo zonke izilwane ezinkulu zingahlasela.
translations.reference: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
translations.hypothesis: While they may appear docile, animals like wolves, elk, moose, bears, and even many other large animals can be aggressive and pose a threat.

translations.source: Unyaka ngamunye, izivakashi eziningi ziyalimala ngenxa yokuthi azigcinanga ibanga elifanele. Lezi zilwane zinkulu, ezasendle, futhi zingaba ingozi, ngakho zinike isikhala sazo.
translations.reference: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
translations.hypothesis: Every year, many visitors are injured because they fail to maintain a safe distance. These are large, wild animals, and they can be dangerous, so it's important to give them their space.

translations.source: Ngaphezu kwalokho, phawula ukuthi iphunga libiza amabhere kanye nezinye izilwane zasendle, ngakho gwema ukuphatha noma ukupheka ukudla okunephunga futhi ugcine ikamu lihlanzekile.
translations.reference: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, please note that strong smells can attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid handling or cooking food with strong odors, and keep the campsite clean.

translations.source: I-Apia inhlokodolobha yaseSamoa. Idolobha lisesiqhingini sase-Upolu futhi linabantu abangaphansi nje kuka-40,000.
translations.reference: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
translations.hypothesis: Apia is the capital city of Samoa. The city is located on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.

translations.source: I-Apia yasungulwa ngabo-1850 futhi yaba yinhlokodolobha ngokomthetho yaseSamowa kusukela ngo-1959.
translations.reference: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Apia was founded in the 1850s and became the official capital of Samoa in 1959.

translations.source: Itheku laliyindawo lapho kwaqubuka khona impi yasolwandle edume kabi ngo-1889 lapho imikhumbi eyisikhombisa evela eJalimane, e-US, naseBrithani yenqaba ukusuka echwebeni.
translations.reference: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
translations.hypothesis: The city was the site of a major naval battle in 1889, where a fleet of warships from Germany, the United States, and Britain engaged in a fierce struggle to break free from a harbor.

translations.source: Yonke imikhumbi yacwila, ngaphandle komkhumbi owodwa wase-Britain. Cishe abantu abangu-200 baseMelika naseJalimane balahlekelwa yizimpilo zabo.
translations.reference: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
translations.hypothesis: All the ships sank, except for a single British vessel. Approximately 200 Americans and Germans lost their lives.

translations.source: Phakathi nomzabalazo wokuzimela ohlelwe yinhlangano kaMau, umhlangano wokuthula edolobheni waholela ekubulaweni kwenkosi yezwe uTupua Tamasese lealofi III.
translations.reference: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
translations.hypothesis: During the independence movement led by the Mau movement, a peaceful demonstration in the city resulted in the assassination of the country's king, Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

translations.source: Kunezingu eziningi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland ingapha nangapha kwamatheku amabili. Ezithandwa kakhulu zisezindaweni ezintathu.
translations.reference: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.hypothesis: There are many beaches, because Auckland is located between two harbors. The most popular ones are found in three main areas.

translations.source: Amabhisi wasoGwini oluseNyakatho (esifundeni seTheku eliseNyakatho) asoLwandlekazini lwePhasifiki futhi asuka e-Long Bay ngasenyakatho kuya e-Devonport eningizimu.
translations.reference: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.hypothesis: The beaches of Gwini, located in the North Coast region (north of Durban), are situated on the Indian Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.

translations.source: Kucishe kube izingu ezinesihlabathi eziyindawo ephephile yokubhukuda, kanti kugcwele nemithunzi eyenziwa izihlahla ze-pohutukawa.
translations.reference: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.hypothesis: The secluded coves offer a safe place for swimming, and are filled with the scent of pohutukawa trees.

translations.source: Amabhishi ase-Tamaki Drive ase-Harbour yase-Waitemata, edolobheni labadla izambane likapondo e-Mission Bay naseSt Heliers e–Auckland eMaphakathi.
translations.reference: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.hypothesis: The yachts docked at Tamaki Drive, along the Waitemata Harbour in Auckland, were enjoying the sunshine in Mission Bay and St Heliers, located in the central part of the city.

translations.source: Lawa amabhishi wemindeni aba nabantu abaningi ngezinye izikhathi anezitolo ezihlukahlukene ezigcwele ogwini. Ukubhukuda kuphephile.
translations.reference: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.hypothesis: These are family-friendly establishments that often have a variety of shops filled with goods. They are generally safe.

translations.source: Ubhiya oyinhloko wasekhaya ‘Uhamba Phambili’, awuwona ubhiya oyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa umnandi futhi uyaqabula. Omunye ubhiya wasekhaya ubizwa ngokuthi “i-Manta”.
translations.reference: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.hypothesis: The main locally brewed beer, called "Uhamba Phambili," is not a complex beer, but it is enjoyable and refreshing. Another locally brewed beer is called "Manta."

translations.source: Kunamawayini amaningi waseFulansi okuphuzwa, kodwa amawayini waseNyuzilandi kanye nase-Australia angahamba kangcono.
translations.reference: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.hypothesis: There are many French wines to choose from, but New Zealand and Australian wines might be a better option.

translations.source: Amanzi asempompini yomphakathi aphephe ngokuphelele ukuthi aphuzwe, kodwa amanzi athengwayo atholakala kalula uma unokwesaba.
translations.reference: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.hypothesis: Public water pumps provide completely safe water for drinking, but bottled water is readily available if you are concerned.

translations.source: Kubantu base-Australia, umcabango wekhofi 'elinobisi oluthunqiswe ngomusi' awujwayelekile. Inkomishi encane 'yi-espresso', i-cappuccino iza igcwele ukhilimu ophezulu (hhayi ugwebu), futhi itiye liphuzwa ngaphandle kobisi.
translations.reference: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.hypothesis: For Australians, the idea of "coffee with condensed milk" is not common. A small cup is called an "espresso," a cappuccino is typically topped with a generous amount of milk (not foam), and tea is usually consumed without milk.

translations.source: Isiphuzo sikashokoledi esishisayo sisemazingeni waseBelgium. Iziphuzo ezenziwe ngezithelo ziyabiza kodwa zikahle kakhulu.
translations.reference: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.hypothesis: The hot chocolate is of Belgian quality. The fruit-based drinks are expensive, but very good.

translations.source: Uhambo oluningi lokuya emkhombeni wekholali (reef) lwenziwa unyaka wonke, futhi izingozi ngenxa yanoma iziphi yalezi zimbangela zasemkhombeni azivamile.
translations.reference: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.hypothesis: Many diving trips are undertaken every year, and accidents due to various underwater hazards are not uncommon.

translations.source: Noma kunjalo, thatha iseluleko seziphathimandla, ulandele zonke izinkomba futhi unakisise izixwayiso sokuphepha.
translations.reference: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.hypothesis: However, always heed the instructions of the authorities, follow all the guidelines, and pay close attention to any safety warnings.

translations.source: Ama-jellyfish asabhokisi abakhona eduze namabhishi naseduze nezizalo zemifula kusukela ngoMfumfu kuya kuMbasa enyakatho ye-1770. Angatholakala ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwalezi zikhathi.
translations.reference: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.hypothesis: Jellyfish blooms have been observed near beaches and during periods of strong currents, from June to August, since the early 1770s. They can sometimes be found outside of these periods as well.

translations.source: Oshaka abekho, nokho abavamisile ukuhlasela abantu. Oshaka abaningi besaba abantu futhi bazobhukuda babaleke.
translations.reference: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.hypothesis: The lions are gone, but they have not stopped attacking people. Many lions are afraid of people and will run away if they are threatened.

translations.source: Izingwenya zamanzi anosawoti azihlali ngokukhululeka olwandle, indawo yazo yokuhlala eyinhloko kusezizalweni zomfula enyakatho kusuka e-Rockhampton.
translations.reference: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: Freshwater crocodiles are commonly found in rivers and estuaries, with their primary habitat being the river systems north of Rockhampton.

translations.source: Ukubhukha kusenesikhathi kunikeza isihambi ukuthula kwengqondo kokuthi sizoba nendawo yokulala kuyo lapho sifika endaweni esiya kuyo.
translations.reference: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.hypothesis: Booking in advance provides travelers with the peace of mind of knowing that they will have a place to stay upon arrival at their destination.

translations.source: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo kaningi ziba nezaphulelo namahhotela athile, nakuba ungakwazi ukubhukha ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlala, njengendawo yamakamu, ngenkampani ehlela uhambo.
translations.reference: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.hypothesis: Travel companies that organize trips often have special deals on certain airlines and hotels, although you may be able to book other types of accommodation, such as apartments, through the travel company.

translations.source: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo zinikeza inhlanganisela yezinto ezihlanganisa ibhulakufesi, amalungiselelo wezinto zokuthutha zokuya/zokusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma isethi ehlangene yendiza kanye nehhotela.
translations.reference: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.hypothesis: Travel companies that organize trips offer packages that include a suitcase, transportation arrangements to and from the airport, or a combined flight and hotel package.

translations.source: Bayakwazi ukukugcinela indawo uma wena usadinga isikhathi sokucabanga noma usafisa ukulungisa izinto ezithinta uhambo lwakho (isb., i-visa).
translations.reference: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.hypothesis: They can hold your reservation if you need more time to think about it or if you need to sort out any details related to your trip (e.g., a visa).

translations.source: Noma iziphi izinguquko noma izicelo nokho kumelwe zidluliselwe enkampanini ehlela uhambo kuqala futhi hhayi nehhotela ngokuqondile.
translations.reference: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.hypothesis: Any changes or requests must be communicated to the travel agency organizing the trip, and not directly to the hotel.

translations.source: Kweminye imikhosi, iningi lababakhona emkhosini womculo linquma ukukanisa kuleyo ndawo, futhi ababakhona abaningi bakubona kuyingxenye edingekayo yokuhlanganyela.
translations.reference: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.hypothesis: In some ceremonies, a significant portion of the attendees actively participate in the musical performance, and many consider this participation to be an essential part of the experience.

translations.source: Uma ufuna ukubona okwenzekayo useduze kuzomelwe ufike masinya ukuze uthole indawo yokukamisa eduze nomculo.
translations.reference: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.hypothesis: If you want to see what's happening near the stage, you should arrive early to secure a good spot close to the music.

translations.source: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo osesiteji esiyinhloko ungaphela, kungaba nezingxenye zomkhosi ezizoqhubeka zidlala umculo kuze kube sebusuku kakhulu.
translations.reference: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.hypothesis: Please remember that while the main stage performances may end, there may be other areas of the festival that continue to have music playing until much later in the evening.

translations.source: Eminye imikhosi inezindawo zokukanisa ezikhethekile zemindeni enezingane ezincane.
translations.reference: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.hypothesis: Some hotels have special areas designed for families with young children.

translations.source: Uma unqamula iNyakatho Baltic ebusika, bheka ukuthi ikuphi indawo yokusandlwana okwakhiwe ngezingodo, njengoba ukuhamba eqhweni kubangela ukungaphatheki kahle emakhaleni kulaba abathinteke kakhulu.
translations.reference: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.hypothesis: If you are traveling in the Baltic region during the winter, be sure to check the location of any ice rinks, as walking on ice can be dangerous for those who are more vulnerable.

translations.source: Uhambo lomkhumbi lwaseSaint Petersburg luhlanganisa idolobha. Kulindelwe ukuthi abahamba ngomkhumbi bahlangabezane nezimfuneko ze-visa (hlola imigomo)
translations.reference: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.hypothesis: The cruise from Saint Petersburg includes a city tour. Passengers are advised to ensure they meet all visa requirements (check the terms and conditions).

translations.source: Amahhlo okugembula ngokujwayelekile enza imizamo yokuba izivakashi zichithe isikhathi nemali eningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Amafasitela namakilogo ngokuvamile awekho, futhi kungaba nzima ukuthola izindawo zokuphuma.
translations.reference: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.hypothesis: Tourist attractions often make efforts to encourage visitors to spend as much time and money as possible. Windows and logos are often absent, and it can be difficult to find exits.

translations.source: Ngokuvamile banokudla okukhethekile, iziphuzo kanye nokuzijabulisa, ukuze bagcine izivakashi zithokozile, futhi bazigcine ziphakathi kwawo.
translations.reference: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.hypothesis: They typically offer special food, drinks, and entertainment to keep guests happy and engaged.

translations.source: Ezinye izindawo zihlinzeka ngotshwala ezindlini. Nokho, ukudakwa kudunga ingqondo, bonke abantu abagembulayo abahle bayakwazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala usangulukile.
translations.reference: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.hypothesis: Some places offer alcohol in their establishments. However, maintaining composure is important, and all respectable individuals understand the value of staying sober.

translations.source: Noma ubani ozoshayela ezindaweni eziphakeme noma ngaphezu kwezintuba zezintaba kumelwe alindele ukuba khona kwesithwathwa, iqhwa, noma amakhaza ashubisa umkantsha.
translations.reference: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone driving in mountainous areas or on roads above the treeline should be prepared for the possibility of strong winds, snow, or ice.

translations.source: Emigwaqweni eneqhwa kanye nomkhithiko, ukuhamba kuyabambezeleka futhi angeke ukwazi ukushayela njengalapho uhamba otiyeleni.
translations.reference: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.hypothesis: Due to the snow and ice, traffic is congested and driving is difficult, similar to driving on ice.

translations.source: Uma kunomoya ohambisana neqhwa, kungawa iqhwa elanele elingakwenza ubhajwe ngesikhashana nje.
translations.reference: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.hypothesis: If there's wind accompanying the snowfall, it can create a blizzard that develops very quickly.

translations.source: Ukubonakala kungavinjelwa ukuwa noma ukufuthwa kweqhwa noma noma ngomswakama noma iqhwa efasiteleni lemoto.
translations.reference: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.hypothesis: Visibility can be reduced by snow or ice accumulating on the windshield of a vehicle, whether it's melting rain or actual snow or ice.

translations.source: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zeqhwa noma zesithwathwa zivamile emazweni amaningi, futhi izimoto zihamba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka cishe unyaka wonke.
translations.reference: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.hypothesis: On the other hand, snowy or icy conditions are common in many countries, and vehicles often operate without disruption for most of the year.

translations.source: Amasafari mhlawumbe yinto enkulu kunazo zonke edonsa izivakashi e-Afrika futhi yinto ethandwa yizivakashi eziningi.
translations.reference: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.hypothesis: Safaris are perhaps the biggest draw for tourists in Africa, and they are a popular activity for many visitors.

translations.source: Igama elithi safari ngokuvamile lisetshenziselwa ukubhekisela ohambweni lokunqamula izwe ukuze ubone izilwane zasendle ezihlaba umxhwele zase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emathafeni.
translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The term "safari" is commonly used to refer to a journey or expedition, typically to observe wildlife in their natural habitat, particularly in Africa, often in safari parks.

translations.source: Ezinye izilwane, njengezindlovu kanye nezindlulamithi, zithanda ukusondela ezimotweni futhi izinto zokubuka ezisezingeni elikahle zizokuvumela ukuthi uzibuke kahle.
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, are attracted to vehicles, and high-quality binoculars will allow you to observe them closely.

translations.source: Amabhubesi, izingulule kanye nezingwe ziyexwaya futhi uzozibona kangcono ngezingilazi zokubuka kude.
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Lions, leopards, and tigers can be seen and observed more clearly through binoculars.

translations.source: Uhambo lokunqamula izwe lwezinyawo (ebizwa nangokuthi "i-bush walk", "hiking safari", noma "footing") luhlanganisa uhambo olude lwezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningana.
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: A walking safari, also known as a "bush walk," "hiking safari," or "foot safari," involves a long journey on foot, which can last for several hours or even several days.

translations.source: Ama-Paralympic azokwenzeka kusukela ngomhla ka-24 kuNcwaba kuya ku-5 kuMandulo 2021. Ezinye izehlakalo zizobanjelwa kwezinye izindawo eJapani yonke.
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will take place from August 24th to September 5th, 2021. Some of the events will be held in various locations throughout Japan.

translations.source: ITokyo kuzoba ilona kuphela idolobha lase-Asia eliphathe imidlalo yama-Olimpiki wasehlobo emibili, eliyiphathe ngo-1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo will be the only city in Asia to have hosted the Summer Olympic Games twice, having previously hosted them in 1964.

translations.source: Uma ubhukhe indiza kanye nendawo yokulala ngo-2020 ngaphambi kokuthi kumenyezelwe ukuhlehliswa, ungase ube sesimweni esinzima.
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If you booked a flight and accommodation in 2020 before the cancellations were announced, you may be in a difficult situation.

translations.source: Izinkambiso zokukhansela ziyahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaNdasa izinkampiso eziningi zokukhansela ngenxa ye-coronavirus azifiki kuNtulikazi 2020, ngenkathi okwakuhlelwe ngayo ama-Olimpiki.
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: Postponements of sporting events have been widespread, and many major sporting events scheduled for the latter half of 2020, including the Olympics, were postponed due to the coronavirus.

translations.source: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi amaningi womcimbi azobiza phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, futhi amathikithi avamile abiza u-¥7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: It is expected that many of the event tickets will be priced between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, while standard tickets will cost ¥7,000.

translations.source: Uku-ayina izingubo ezimanzi kungazisiza zome. Amahhotela amaningi ane-ayini nebhodi yoku-ayina etholakalayo ngokubolekwa, noma ngabe eyodwa ingekho egumbini.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: Using a clothes dryer can help clothes dry faster. Many hotels offer laundry services and have dryers available for guest use, either for a fee or sometimes included with the room.

translations.source: Uma i-ayina ingekho, noma uma ungagqoki amasokisi abizayo a-ayiniwe, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokomisa izinwele, uma ukhona.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have any tights, or if you don't want to wear thick, opaque tights, you can try using a hair dryer.

translations.source: Qaphela ukuba ungavumeli indwangu ukuba ishise kakhulu (okungayenza ukuthi ishwaqe, noma ezimweni ezidlulele, ihamuke).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Please be aware that you should not allow the fabric to get too hot (as this could cause it to melt or, in extreme cases, catch fire).

translations.source: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye ezisebenza kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile eziwusongo.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are many methods for purifying water, and some are more effective than others depending on the specific circumstances and challenges.

translations.source: Kwezinye izindawo ukubilisa amanzi umzuzu kwanele, kwezinye kudingeka imizuzu eminingana.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some places, boiling water for just a minute is sufficient, while in other places, it may require several minutes.

translations.source: Izihlungi ziyahluka ngempumelelo, uma ungaba nokukhathazeka, kumelwe ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi wakho ebhodleni elivaliwe enkampanini ethenjwayo.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: Water filters vary in effectiveness, so if you're concerned, you should consider purchasing your water from a reputable company that uses a sealed bottling process.

translations.source: Izihambi zingahlangabezana nezifo zezilwane ezingazijwaleyanga ezindaweni zangakuzo.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers may encounter unusual animal diseases in the areas they visit.

translations.source: Izilokazane zingakonakalisa ukudla, zicasule, noma okubi nakakhulu zenze kusigulise, zisakaze ubuthi, noma zisakaze izifo.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Contaminants can spoil food, make it taste bad, or, even worse, make people sick, cause poisoning, or spread diseases.

translations.source: Izifo ezithelelwanayo ngokwazo, noma izilwane eziyingozi ezingalimaza noma zibulale umuntu ngamandla, azivamile ukufaneleka njengezilwane ezifuywayo.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Animals that are inherently dangerous, or that pose a significant risk of injury or death to humans, are generally not considered suitable as domestic animals.

translations.source: Ukuthenga izimpahla ezingakhokhiswa intela kuyithuba lokuthenga izimpahla ezikhishwe izintela kanye nentela yezimpahla ezindaweni ezithile.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: Shopping for tax-free goods is an opportunity to purchase items that are either exempt from taxes or have had the tax already paid on them, often in specific locations.

translations.source: Izihambi eziya emazweni akhokhisa intela ephezulu kwesinye isikhathi zingonga imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezidakayo nogwayi.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Travelers visiting countries with high tax rates can sometimes save a significant amount of money, particularly on goods like alcoholic beverages and tobacco.

translations.source: Indawo ephakathi kwe-Point Marion ne-Fairmont yenza izimo zokushayela ezinzima kakhulu eMgwaqweni omkhulu wase-Buffalo-Pittsburgh, odlula njalo ezindaweni ezingenabantu zasemahlathini.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The area between Point Marion and Fairmont creates particularly challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Turnpike, which runs through largely uninhabited forest areas.

translations.source: Uma ungajwayele ukushayela emigwaqweni yasemaphandleni, hlala uphapheme: izindawo eziyimiqansa kakhulu, izindlela eziwungcingo, kanye namajika amabi agcwele.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: If you are not used to driving on rural roads, be cautious: they can be very uneven, have narrow lanes, and be full of sharp turns.

translations.source: Ukulinganiselwa kwesivinini okusemabhodini kuphansi ngokuphawulekayo kunasezingxenyeni zangaphambili nezilandelayo — ngokuvamile u-35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — futhi ukukunakisisa kubalulekile nakakhulu kunokungakunakisisi.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: The speed limits on the lower levels are significantly lower than on the preceding and following sections—typically 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)—and paying attention to these limits is particularly important.

translations.source: Ngokumangazayo, nokho, insiza yefoni ephathekayo inamandla kakhulu lapha kunezindlela eziningi eziningi zomzila, isb. ePennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, however, mobile phone coverage is surprisingly good in many remote areas, such as the Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: Ukudla kwaseJalimane okubhakwayo kuhle empeleni, futhi eBavaria, kunothile futhi kuhlukile, kuyafana nalokho kwasendaweni engumakhelwane engaseningizimu, i-Austria.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: German cuisine is truly excellent, and in Bavaria, it is particularly delicious and distinctive, similar to the cuisine of the neighboring country to the south, Austria.

translations.source: Ukudla okubhakwayo kwezithelo kuvamile, okunama-apula aphekwayo afakwa ezintweni ezibhakwayo unyaka wonke, kanye nama-cherry namapulamu evela ngehlobo.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: Baked fruit dishes are common, with cooked apples often used in baked goods throughout the year, and cherries and plums appearing in the summer.

translations.source: Okuningi kokudla kwaseJalimane okubhakiwe kubuye kube nama-almondi, izindlubu zomhezela, kanye nezinye izindlubu zemithi. Amakhekhe athandwayo avame ukuhambisana kahle kakhulu nenkomishi yekhofi enamandla.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Many German baked goods also contain almonds, walnuts, and other types of nuts. These pastries are often best enjoyed with a strong cup of coffee.

translations.source: Uma ufuna uphayi omncane kodwa onothile, zama lokho okubizwa kuye ngendawo ngokuthi iBerliner, iPfannkuchen noma iKrapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you're looking for a small but satisfying treat, try what is locally known as a Berliner, Pfannkuchen, or Krapfen.

translations.source: Ukhari yisidlo esisuselwa kumakhambi nezinongo, kuhlanganiswe ndawonye mhlawumbe nenyama noma imifino.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: Curry is a dish made with a sauce or gravy, typically flavored with spices, and often containing meat or vegetables.

translations.source: Ukhari ungaba “manzi” noma “wome” kuya ngesikali samanzi.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: The consistency of the porridge can be "thin" or "thick," depending on the water content.

translations.source: Izindawo ezimaphakathi nezwe zaseNyakatho yeNdiya nePakistan, iyogathi ivamise ukusetshenziswa ezitshuliwni; eNingizimu neNdiya kanye nasezindaweni ezinye ezisogwini zezwekazi, ubisi lukakhukhunathi luvamise ukusetshenziswa.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In the northern regions of India and Pakistan, clarified butter (ghee) is commonly used in cooking; in southern India and other urban areas, vegetable oil is more frequently used.

translations.source: Ngeziqhingi ezingu-17,000 ongakhetha kuzo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia igama elihlanganisa izinhlobo eziningi zokudlwa kwendawo okutholakala ezweni lonke.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: With over 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian cuisine is a diverse collection of regional dishes found throughout the archipelago.

translations.source: Kodwa, uma lisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwenye incazelo, igama livame ukusho ukudla ekuqaleni okusuka ezingxenyeni ezimaphakathi kanye nezisempumalanga yesiqhingi esiyinhloko iJava.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: However, when used without further clarification, the term typically refers to food originating from the central and eastern regions of the main island of Java.

translations.source: Manje okutholakala kabanzi eqoqweni leziqhingi lonke, ukudla kwaseJava kuhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunongwe kalula, lapho isinongo esivelele kubantu baseJava kungamantongomane, upelepele, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela waseJava kakhukhunathi) kanye nezinye izinongo ezinamakha.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Nowadays, widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine includes a variety of snacks, and a staple food for many Javanese people are snacks, cakes, cookies (especially Javanese sweet snacks), and other pastries.

translations.source: Izitibili izinto zokusekela izinyawo zomgibeli ezilenga ezingxenyeni zonke zesihlalo sehhashi.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: The footrests are support structures for the rider's feet, located at the front of the motorcycle seat.

translations.source: Zinikeza ukuzinza emgibelini kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yamathuba okuba izinyawo zomgibeli zibhajwe kuzo.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They offer stability on the track but can pose safety concerns due to the risk of the track's wheels becoming trapped within them.

translations.source: Uma umgibeli ewiswa yihashi kodwa unyawo lwakhe lubambeke esitibilini, angahuduleka uma ihhashi libaleka. Ukunciphisa lengozi, izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuphepha zingathathwa.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: If a rider is thrown from a horse but their leg is caught in the stirrup, they are at risk of being dragged if the horse runs off. To minimize this risk, several safety precautions can be taken.

translations.source: Okokuqala, abagibeli abaningi bagqoka amabhuzi okugibela anesithende kanye nesoli ebushelelezi, elincane kakhulu.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: Firstly, many cyclists wear cycling jerseys that are lightweight, breathable, and have a close fit.

translations.source: Okulandelayo, ezinye izihlalo zehhashi, ngokukhethekile izihlalo zamaNgisi, zinezinsimbi zokuphepha ezivumela isikhumba sesitibili ukuba siwe esihlalweni lapho isihlalo sidonswelwa emuva umgibeli owayo.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: Next, some racing car seats, particularly those used in Formula 1, have safety features that allow the driver's body to sink into the seat as the seat is pushed backward during a crash.

translations.source: I-Cochamo Valley – indawo eyinhloko abaqhwali abafuna ukufika kuyo e-Chile, yaziwa nangokuthi i-Yosemite yaseNingizimu Melika, enezinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zezindonga ezinkulu ezakhiwe nge-granite kanye nemisele.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: The Cochamo Valley – a prime destination for climbers in Chile, also known as the "Yosemite of South America" – is famous for its diverse range of large granite walls and rock formations.

translations.source: Iziqongo zihlanganisa izindawo zokubona izindawo ezinhle kakhulu ezihlokweni. Abagibeli abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba bayaqhubeka ngokuthola imizila emisha phakathi kwezindawo ezingapheli ezingaba izindonga.
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: These landscapes encompass the most beautiful places in the world, and travelers from all corners of the globe continue to discover new paths and experiences within these timeless and inspiring environments.

translations.source: Imidlalo yeqhwa ekwehleni, ehlanganisa ukushushuluza eqhweni ne-snowboarding, imidlalo edumile ehlanganisa ukuslayida phansi endaweni embozwe yiqhwa ngama-skis noma ibhodi leqhwa elinamathiselwe ezinyaweni zakho.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Winter sports, including skiing and snowboarding, are popular activities that involve sliding down a snow-covered slope using skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.

translations.source: Ukushushuluza eqhweni umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhamba onabashisekeli abaningi, kwezinye izikhathi abaziwa ngokuthi ama-"ski bums," abahlela ukuvakasha konke ukuze bashushuluze eqhweni endaweni ethile.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Exploring a ski resort with a large group of people, often referred to as "ski bums," involves planning a trip specifically to enjoy skiing in a particular location.

translations.source: Umcabango wokushushuluza eqhweni owakudala kakhulu — imidwebo yasemihumeni eveza abashushuluzi baseqhweni ihlehlela emuva ku-5000 BC!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: The practice of tattooing is very ancient – archaeological evidence of tattoos dates back as far as 5000 BC!

translations.source: Ukushushuluza eqhweni wehla entabeni njengomhlalo kuhlehlela emuva okungenani ekhulwini lama-17 leminyaka, futhi ngo-1861 iqembu lokushushuluza eqhweni kokuzilibazisa lavulwa abantu baseNorway e-Australia.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The practice of skiing, as a form of recreation, dates back at least 17 centuries, and in 1861, the first ski club for recreational purposes was established by Norwegians in Australia.

translations.source: Ukushushuluza eqhweni ngesikhwama: Lokhu kubuye kubizwe ngokuthi ukushushuluza eqhweni emaphandleni, ukubona indawo ngokushushulaza eqhweni kanye nokushushuluza eqhweni kokuqwala izintaba.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Hiking with a backpack: This is also known as backpacking, exploring the outdoors on foot, or hiking in mountainous areas.

translations.source: Kuhlobene kodwa akuhlanganisi isitayela se-alpine sokuvakasha noma ukuqwala izintaba, okwenziwe abanye kamuva ezindaweni ezingamawa futhi ezidinga izinduku zokuhamba eqhweni eziqinile kakhudlwana kanye namabhuthi.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: While related, alpine tourism or mountaineering differs from other forms of outdoor recreation. It often takes place in remote areas and requires specialized equipment, including sturdy hiking poles and boots.

translations.source: Cabanga ngendlela yokushushuluza eqhweni njengendlela efanayo yokuqwala izintaba.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Imagine the way a river carves its path through a valley, much like how erosion shapes mountains.

translations.source: Ezimweni ezinhle uzokwazi ukuhamba cishe ibanga elide kunokuhamba ngezinyawo – kodwa ngokwethukela okukhulu kuphela ungathola isivinini sokushushuluza eqhweni ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ngaphandle kwesikhwama esisindayo emizileni elungisiwe.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: In good conditions, you can cover a much greater distance by cycling than by walking – but only with a significant amount of effort can you achieve a brisk pace on uneven terrain without a sturdy frame and well-maintained tires.

translations.source: IYurophu izwekali elincane ngokwesilinganiso kodwa elinamazwe amaningi azimele. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, ukuthatha uhambo emazweni amaningana kungasho ukubhalisela i-visa kanye nokudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona amaphasiphoti kaningana.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent, but it consists of many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, traveling to several countries within Europe can involve applying for multiple visas and going through passport control checks on numerous occasions.

translations.source: Indawo yaseSchengen, nokho, isebenza ngandlelathile njengezwe elilodwa kulokhu.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: However, the Schengen area functions, in practice, as a single country.

translations.source: Uma nje uhlala kulendawo, ngokuvamile ungeqa imingcele ngaphandle kokuba kuhlolwe iphasiphothi yakho futhi.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: If you live in a certain area, you can usually cross the border without having your passport checked.

translations.source: Ngokufanayo, ngokuba ne-visa ye-Schengen, awudingi ukubhalisela i-visa yezwe ngalinye ngokuhlukile kulawo angamalungu e-Shengen, okonga isikhathi, imali kanye nomsebenzi wokugcwalisa amafomu.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, having a Schengen visa means you don't need to apply for a separate visa for each Schengen member country, which saves you time, money, and the effort of filling out multiple forms.

translations.source: Ayikho neze incazelo ekhona yokuthi lemikhiqizo eyenziwe kwabe kungeyakudala. Izinhlangano zentela zichaza izinto esezidlulelwe yiminyaka engu-100 njengama gugu.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no established definition of what constitutes an "antique" product. Tax authorities generally classify items that are over 100 years old as antiques.

translations.source: Incazelo inokwehluka kwendawo, lapho isilinganiso sobudala singaba sifishane ezindaweni ezinjengaseNyakatho Melika kunaseYurophu.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The life expectancy can vary by region, with lower rates often observed in areas like North America compared to Europe.

translations.source: Imikhiqizo yezandla ingahle ichazwe njengezinto zakudala, nakuba imincane kunempahla efanaya ekhiqizwa ngobuningi.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: Handmade products can be described as artisanal goods, although they are typically produced in smaller quantities compared to mass-produced items.

translations.source: Ukufuya ama-reindeer indlela ebalulekile yokuziphilisa phakathi kwamaSámi futhi isiko elizungeze lomsebenzi libalulekile futhi nakwabanye abaneminye imisebenzi.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: Reindeer herding is a vital way of life for the Sami people, and the culture surrounding this practice is significant, even for those who pursue other occupations.

translations.source: Ngisho nangokwesiko, nokho, akuwona wonke amaSámi ayehlanganyele ngokugcwele ekufuyeni izinyamazane, kodwa ayephila ngokudoba, ukuzingela nokufanayo, besebenzisa izinyamazane njengezilwane eziboshelwayo.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: However, even according to tradition, not all Sami people were fully involved in falconry; some lived by hunting, trapping, and similar activities, using birds of prey as hunting tools.

translations.source: Namuhla abaningi abantu bama-Sámi abasebenza kwezohwebo zesimanje. Ezokuvakasha ngumholo obalulekile e-Sápmi, endaweni yama-Sámi.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Today, many Sami people work in modern industries. Tourism is a significant source of income in Sápmi, the Sami homeland.

translations.source: Nakuba lisetshenziswa kabanzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abangewona amaRomany, igama elithi "Gypsy" kaningi lithathwa njengelokwedelela ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwalo nezinto ezimbi eziyiphutha ezishiwo abanye kanye nemibono enganembile ngabantu bamaRomany.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: While the term "Gypsy" is widely used, particularly by non-Roma people, it is often considered offensive due to its association with negative stereotypes and misinformation about Roma people.

translations.source: Uma izwe ozolivakashela lithola izixwayiso zokuphepha ezingokomthetho, umshwalense wakho wohambo wempilo noma umshwalense wakho wokukhansela uhambo ungathinteka.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If the country you are visiting issues travel advisories, your health insurance or travel cancellation insurance may be affected.

translations.source: Ungafisa nokuhlola izeluleko zohulumeni ngaphandle kowakho, kodwa izeluleko ziklanyelwe izakhamuzi zawo.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: You may want to explore government guidelines independently, but these guidelines are designed for its citizens.
